274.s: de̱vī u̱ṣāsā̱naktendra̍ṃ ya̱jñe praya̍tyahvetām daivī̱rviśa̍: prāyā̍siṣṭā̱m̐ suprī̍te su̱dhite̍ vasuva̱ne̍ vasudhe̱yasya vī̱tāṃ yaja̍
274.d: दे̱वी उ̱षासा̱नक्तेन्द्र̍ं य̱ज्ञे प्रय̍त्यह्वेताम् दैवी̱र्विश̍: प्राया̍सिष्टा̱म्̐ सुप्री̍ते सु̱धिते̍ वसुव̱ने̍ वसुधे̱यस्य वी̱तां यज̍
274.m: The two divine ones, Dawn and Night, called upon Indra as the sacrifice went forward. / Well-pleased, well-placed, the divine clans strove forward; for the winning of wealth, may the two enjoy the foundation of wealth. Sacrifice.

274.s: de̱vī joṣṭrī̍ vasu̍dhitī de̱vamindra̍mavardhatām | ayā̍vya̱nyāghā dveṣā̍m̐syā̱nyā va̍kṣa̱dvasu̍ vāryā̍ṇi̱ yaja̍mānāya śikṣate̱ vasu̍vane̍ vasudhe̱yasya vī̱tāṃ yaja̍
274.d: दे̱वी जोष्ट्री̍ वसु̍धिती दे̱वमिन्द्र̍मवर्धताम् । अया̍व्य̱न्याघा द्वेषा̍म्̐स्या̱न्या व̍क्ष̱द्वसु̍ वार्या̍णि̱ यज̍मानाय शिक्षते̱ वसु̍वने̍ वसुधे̱यस्य वी̱तां यज̍
274.m: May the two divine female cherishers, the foundations of wealth, magnify the god Indra. / May the one keep away the wicked hatreds; may the other bring desirable goods for the sacrificer who strives; for the winning of wealth, may the two enjoy the foundation of wealth. Sacrifice.

274.s: de̱vī ū̱rjāhu̍tī du̱ghe sudughe paya̱sendra̍mavardhatām iṣa̱mūrja̍ma̱nyā va̍kṣatsa̱gdhim̐ sapī̍tima̱nyā nave̍na̱ pūrva̱ṃ daya̍māne purā̱ṇena̱ nava̱madhā̍tā̱mūrja̱mūrjā̍hutī ū̱rjaya̍māne̱ vasu̱ vāryā̍ṇi̱ yaja̍mānāya śikṣate̱ vasu̍vane̍ vasudhe̱yasya vī̱tāṃ yaja̍
274.d: दे̱वी ऊ̱र्जाहु̍ती दु̱घे सुदुघे पय̱सेन्द्र̍मवर्धताम् इष̱मूर्ज̍म̱न्या व̍क्षत्स̱ग्धिम्̐ सपी̍तिम̱न्या नवे̍न̱ पूर्व̱ं दय̍माने पुरा̱णेन̱ नव̱मधा̍ता̱मूर्ज̱मूर्जा̍हुती ऊ̱र्जय̍माने̱ वसु̱ वार्या̍णि̱ यज̍मानाय शिक्षते̱ वसु̍वने̍ वसुधे̱यस्य वी̱तां यज̍
274.m: The two divine offerers of strength, yielding milk, easily milked, magnified Indra with milk. / May the one bring refreshment and strength; may the other [bring] common food and common drink. Protecting the old with the new, the two have established the new with the old strength; the two offerers of strength, refreshing, [bring] desirable goods for the sacrificer who strives; for the winning of wealth, may the two enjoy the foundation of wealth. Sacrifice.

274.s: de̱vā daivyā̱ hotā̍rā de̱vamindra̍mavardhatām ha̱tāgha̍śam̐sā̱ ābhārṣṭā̱ṃ vasu̱ vāryā̍ṇi̱ yaja̍mānāya śikṣatau̱ vasu̍vane̍ vasudhe̱yasya vī̱tāṃ yaja̍
274.d: दे̱वा दैव्या̱ होता̍रा दे̱वमिन्द्र̍मवर्धताम् ह̱ताघ̍शम्̐सा̱ आभार्ष्टा̱ं वसु̱ वार्या̍णि̱ यज̍मानाय शिक्षतौ̱ वसु̍वने̍ वसुधे̱यस्य वी̱तां यज̍
274.m: May the two divine Hotṛs magnify the god Indra. / Having slain the evil-speaking, may they bring desirable goods for the sacrificer who strives; for the winning of wealth, may the two enjoy the foundation of wealth. Sacrifice.

274.s: de̱vīsti̱srasti̱sro de̱vī: pati̱mindra̍mavardhayan aspṛ̍kṣa̱dbhāra̍tī di̱vaṃm̐ ru̱drairya̱jñam̐ sara̍svatīḷā vasu̍matī gṛ̱hānva̍suva̱ne̍ vasudhe̱yasya vyantu̱ yaja̍
274.d: दे̱वीस्ति̱स्रस्ति̱स्रो दे̱वी: पति̱मिन्द्र̍मवर्धयन् अस्पृ̍क्ष̱द्भार̍ती दि̱वंम्̐ रु̱द्रैर्य̱ज्ञम्̐ सर̍स्वतीऌआ वसु̍मती गृ̱हान्व̍सुव̱ने̍ वसुधे̱यस्य व्यन्तु̱ यज̍
274.m:
The three divine goddesses made their lord Indra flourish:
Bhāratī touched heaven, Sarasvatī with the Rudras the sacrifice, wealthy Iḷā the homesteads. For the winning of wealth, let them partake of the wealth-store; sacrifice!

274.s: de̱va indro̱ narā̱śam̐sa̍strivarū̱thastri̍ba̱ndhuro̍ de̱vamindra̍mavardhayat śa̱tena̍ śiti̱pṛṣṭhānā̱māhi̍ta: sa̱hasre̍ṇa̱ pra va̍rtate mi̱trāvaru̍ṇeda̱sya ho̱tramarha̍to bṛha̱spati̍ sto̱trama̱śvinā̍dhva̱ryava̍ṃ vasuva̱ne̍ vasudhe̱yasya vetu̱ yaja̍
274.d: दे̱व इन्द्रो̱ नरा̱शम्̐स̍स्त्रिवरू̱थस्त्रि̍ब̱न्धुरो̍ दे̱वमिन्द्र̍मवर्धयत् श̱तेन̍ शिति̱पृष्ठाना̱माहि̍त: स̱हस्रे̍ण̱ प्र व̍र्तते मि̱त्रावरु̍णेद̱स्य हो̱त्रमर्ह̍तो बृह̱स्पति̍ स्तो̱त्रम̱श्विना̍ध्व̱र्यव̍ं वसुव̱ने̍ वसुधे̱यस्य वेतु̱ यज̍
274.m:
The divine Indra, Narāśaṃsa, having three shelters, having three seats, made divine Indra flourish.
Borne by a hundred, he advances with a thousand white-backed [steeds]; Mitra and Varuṇa are worthy of his Hotṛ-office, Bṛhaspati of the chant, the Aśvins of the Adhvaryu-office. For the winning of wealth, let him partake of the wealth-store; sacrifice!

274.s: de̱vo de̱vairva̍na̱spati̍rhira̍ṇyaparṇo madhu̍śākha: supippa̱lo de̱vamindra̍mavardhayat di̱vamagrai̍ṇāspṛkṣadāntari̍kṣaṃ pṛthi̱vīma̍dṛm̐hīdvasuva̱ne̍ vasudhe̱yasya vetu̱ yaja̍
274.d: दे̱वो दे̱वैर्व̍न̱स्पति̍र्हिर̍ण्यपर्णो मधु̍शाख: सुपिप्प̱लो दे̱वमिन्द्र̍मवर्धयत् दि̱वमग्रै̍णास्पृक्षदान्तरि̍क्षं पृथि̱वीम̍दृम्̐हीद्वसुव̱ने̍ वसुधे̱यस्य वेतु̱ यज̍
274.m:
The divine Vanaspati, with the gods, golden-leaved, sweet-branched, having fine fruit, made divine Indra flourish.
With his top he touched heaven, he [filled] mid-air, he made the earth firm. For the winning of wealth, let him partake of the wealth-store; sacrifice!

274.s: de̱vaṃ ba̱rhirvā̍ri̱tīnā̍ṃ de̱vamindra̍mavardhayat svā̱sa̱sthamindre̍ṇāsa̍nnama̱nyā ba̱rhīm̐ṣya̱bhya̍bhūdvasuva̱ne̍ vasudhe̱yasya vetu̱ yaja̍
274.d: दे̱वं ब̱र्हिर्वा̍रि̱तीना̍ं दे̱वमिन्द्र̍मवर्धयत् स्वा̱स̱स्थमिन्द्रे̍णास̍न्नम̱न्या ब̱र्हीम्̐ष्य̱भ्य̍भूद्वसुव̱ने̍ वसुधे̱यस्य वेतु̱ यज̍
274.m:
The divine sacred grass made divine Indra of the water-streams flourish;
Providing a good seat, seated with Indra, it surpassed the other sacred grasses. For the winning of wealth, let him partake of the wealth-store; sacrifice!

274.s: de̱vo a̱gniḥ sviṣṭa̱kṛdde̱vamindra̍mavardhayat svi̱ṣṭaṃ ku̱rvan tsvi̍ṣṭa̱kṛtsvi̍ṣṭama̱dya ka̍rotu no vasuva̱ne̍ vasudhe̱ya̍sya vetu̱ yaja̍
274.d: दे̱वो अ̱ग्निः स्विष्ट̱कृद्दे̱वमिन्द्र̍मवर्धयत् स्वि̱ष्टं कु̱र्वन् त्स्वि̍ष्ट̱कृत्स्वि̍ष्टम̱द्य क̍रोतु नो वसुव̱ने̍ वसुधे̱य̍स्य वेतु̱ यज̍
274.m:
The divine Agni Sviṣṭakṛt made divine Indra flourish;
Making a good offering, may Sviṣṭakṛt today make our offering good. For the winning of wealth, let him partake of the wealth-store; sacrifice!

274.s: a̱gnima̱dya hotā̍ramavṛṇītā̱yaṃ yaja̍māna̱ḥ paca̱npaktīḥ paca̍npuro̱ḍāśā̍m̐ ba̱dhnannindrā̍ya̱ cchāga̍m sūpa̱sthā a̱dya de̱vo vana̱spati̍rabhava̱dindrā̍ya̱ cchāge̍na agha̍tta̱ṃ meda̍sta̱ḥ prati̍ paca̱tāgra̍bhīdavī̍vṛdhatpuro̱ḍāśe̍na | tvāma̱dya ṛ̍ṣe
274.d: अ̱ग्निम̱द्य होता̍रमवृणीता̱यं यज̍मान̱ः पच̱न्पक्तीः पच̍न्पुरो̱डाशा̍म्̐ ब̱ध्नन्निन्द्रा̍य̱ च्छाग̍म् सूप̱स्था अ̱द्य दे̱वो वन̱स्पति̍रभव̱दिन्द्रा̍य̱ च्छागे̍न अघ̍त्त̱ं मेद̍स्त̱ः प्रति̍ पच̱ताग्र̍भीदवी̍वृधत्पुरो̱डाशे̍न । त्वाम̱द्य ऋ̍षे

275.s: hotā̍ yakṣatsamidhā̱naṃ maha̱dyaśa̍ḥ su̱sami̍ddha̱ṃ vare̍ṇyama̱gnimindra̍ṃ vayo̱dhasa̍m gāya̱trīṃ chanda̍ indri̱yaṃ trya̱viṃ gāṃ vayo̍ dadha̱dvetvājya̍sya̱ hota̱ryaja̍
275.d: होता̍ यक्षत्समिधा̱नं मह̱द्यश̍ः सु̱समि̍द्ध̱ं वरे̍ण्यम̱ग्निमिन्द्र̍ं वयो̱धस̍म् गाय̱त्रीं छन्द̍ इन्द्रि̱यं त्र्य̱विं गां वयो̍ दध̱द्वेत्वाज्य̍स्य̱ होत̱र्यज̍
275.m:
May the Hotṛ sacrifice to the kindled, great fame, well-kindled, choice Agni, to Indra the bestower of vigor,
Bestowing the Gāyatrī metre, manly power, a three-year-old bull, vigor. Let him partake of the clarified butter; O Hotṛ, sacrifice!

275.s: hotā̍ yakṣatta̱nūnapā̍tamu̱dbhida̱ṃ yaṃ garbha̱madi̍ti̱rdadhe śuci̱mindra̍ṃ vayo̱dhasa̍m u̱ṣṇiha̱ṃ chanda̍ indri̱yaṃ di̍tya̱vāha̱ṃ gāṃ vayo̍ dadha̱dvetvājya̍sya̱ hota̱ryaja̍
275.d: होता̍ यक्षत्त̱नूनपा̍तमु̱द्भिद̱ं यं गर्भ̱मदि̍ति̱र्दधे शुचि̱मिन्द्र̍ं वयो̱धस̍म् उ̱ष्णिह̱ं छन्द̍ इन्द्रि̱यं दि̍त्य̱वाह̱ं गां वयो̍ दध̱द्वेत्वाज्य̍स्य̱ होत̱र्यज̍
275.m:
May the Hotṛ sacrifice to Tanūnapāt, the breaking-forth, whom as an embryo Aditi bore, the pure Indra, the bestower of vigor,
Bestowing the Uṣṇih metre, manly power, a two-year-old steer, vigor. Let him partake of the clarified butter; O Hotṛ, sacrifice!

275.s: hotā̍ yakṣadīḷe̱nya̍mīḷi̱taṃ vṛ̍tra̱hanta̍mamiḷā̍bhirīḍyam̐ sa̱haḥ soma̱mindra̍ṃ vayo̱dhasa̍m a̱nu̱ṣṭubha̱ṃ chanda̍ indri̱yaṃ pañcā̱viṃ gāṃ vayo̍ dadha̱dvetvājya̍sya̱ hota̱ryaja̍
275.d: होता̍ यक्षदीऌए̱न्य̍मीऌइ̱तं वृ̍त्र̱हन्त̍ममिऌआ̍भिरीड्यम्̐ स̱हः सोम̱मिन्द्र̍ं वयो̱धस̍म् अ̱नु̱ष्टुभ̱ं छन्द̍ इन्द्रि̱यं पञ्चा̱विं गां वयो̍ दध̱द्वेत्वाज्य̍स्य̱ होत̱र्यज̍
275.m:
May the Hotṛ sacrifice to the praiseworthy, praised, greatest slayer of Vṛtra, to be praised with praises, the overpowering force, Soma, to Indra the bestower of vigor,
Bestowing the Anuṣṭubh metre, manly power, a two-and-a-half-year-old steer, vigor. Let him partake of the clarified butter; O Hotṛ, sacrifice!

275.s: hotā̍ yakṣatsuba̱rhiṣa̍ṃ pū̱ṣaṇva̍nta̱mama̍rtyam̐ sīda̍ntaṃ ba̱rhiṣi̍ pri̱ye'mṛ̍tendra̍ṃ vayo̱dhasa̍m bṛ̱hatī̱ṃ chanda̍ indri̱yaṃ tri̍va̱tsaṃ gāṃ vayo̍ dadha̱dvetvājya̍sya̱ hota̱ryaja̍
275.d: होता̍ यक्षत्सुब̱र्हिष̍ं पू̱षण्व̍न्त̱मम̍र्त्यम्̐ सीद̍न्तं ब̱र्हिषि̍ प्रि̱येऽमृ̍तेन्द्र̍ं वयो̱धस̍म् बृ̱हती̱ं छन्द̍ इन्द्रि̱यं त्रि̍व̱त्सं गां वयो̍ दध̱द्वेत्वाज्य̍स्य̱ होत̱र्यज̍
275.m:
May the Hotṛ sacrifice to him who has good sacred grass, accompanied by Pūṣan, the immortal, seated on his dear sacred grass, to immortal Indra the bestower of vigor,
Bestowing the Bṛhatī metre, manly power, a three-year-old steer, vigor. Let him partake of the clarified butter; O Hotṛ, sacrifice!

275.s: hotā̍ yakṣadvyaca̍svatīḥ suprāya̱ṇā ṛ̍tā̱vṛdho̱ dvāro̍ de̱vīrhi̍ra̱ṇyayī̍rbra̱hmāṇa̱mindra̍ṃ vayo̱dhasa̍m pa̱ṅktiṃ chanda̍ i̱hendri̱yaṃ tu̍rya̱vāha̱ṃ gāṃ vayo̍ dadha̱dvyantvājya̍sya̱ hota̱ryaja̍
275.d: होता̍ यक्षद्व्यच̍स्वतीः सुप्राय̱णा ऋ̍ता̱वृधो̱ द्वारो̍ दे̱वीर्हि̍र̱ण्ययी̍र्ब्र̱ह्माण̱मिन्द्र̍ं वयो̱धस̍म् प̱ङ्क्तिं छन्द̍ इ̱हेन्द्रि̱यं तु̍र्य̱वाह̱ं गां वयो̍ दध̱द्व्यन्त्वाज्य̍स्य̱ होत̱र्यज̍
275.m:
May the Hotṛ sacrifice to the spacious, easily traversed, cosmic-order-increasing, divine golden Doors, to the priest Indra the bestower of vigor,
Bestowing the Paṅkti metre, manly power here, a four-year-old steer, vigor. Let them partake of the clarified butter; O Hotṛ, sacrifice!

275.s: hotā̍ yakṣatsu̱peśa̍sā su̱śilpe bṛ̍ha̱tī u̱bhe naktoṣāsā̱ na da̍rśa̱te viśva̱mindra̍ṃ vayo̱dhasa̍m tri̱ṣṭubha̱ṃ chanda̍ i̱hendri̱yaṃ pa̍ṣṭha̱vāha̱ṃ gāṃ vayo̍ dadha̍dvītāmājya̍sya̱ hota̱ryaja̍
275.d: होता̍ यक्षत्सु̱पेश̍सा सु̱शिल्पे बृ̍ह̱ती उ̱भे नक्तोषासा̱ न द̍र्श̱ते विश्व̱मिन्द्र̍ं वयो̱धस̍म् त्रि̱ष्टुभ̱ं छन्द̍ इ̱हेन्द्रि̱यं प̍ष्ठ̱वाह̱ं गां वयो̍ दध̍द्वीतामाज्य̍स्य̱ होत̱र्यज̍
275.m:
May the Hotṛ sacrifice to the well-formed, well-fashioned, lofty both, Night and Dawn, wondrous to behold, to the all, to Indra the bestower of vigor,
Bestowing the Triṣṭubh metre, manly power here, a five-year-old steer, vigor. Let the two partake of the clarified butter; O Hotṛ, sacrifice!

275.s: hotā̍ yakṣatprace̍tasā de̱vānā̍mutta̱maṃ yaśo̱ hotā̍rā daivyā̍ ka̱vī sa̱yujendra̍ṃ vayo̱dhasa̍m jaga̍tī̱ṃ chanda̍ indri̱yama̍na̱ḍvāha̱ṃ gāṃ vayo̍ dadha̍dvītāmājya̍sya̱ hota̱ryaja̍
275.d: होता̍ यक्षत्प्रचे̍तसा दे̱वाना̍मुत्त̱मं यशो̱ होता̍रा दैव्या̍ क̱वी स̱युजेन्द्र̍ं वयो̱धस̍म् जग̍ती̱ं छन्द̍ इन्द्रि̱यम̍न̱ड्वाह̱ं गां वयो̍ दध̍द्वीतामाज्य̍स्य̱ होत̱र्यज̍
275.m:
May the Hotṛ sacrifice to the two wise ones, the supreme glory of the gods, the two divine Hotṛs, the two sages, to their yoke-fellow Indra the bestower of vigor,
Bestowing the Jagatī metre, manly power, a draft-ox, vigor. Let the two partake of the clarified butter; O Hotṛ, sacrifice!

275.s: hotā̍ yakṣa̱tpeśa̍svatīsti̱sro de̱vīrhi̍ra̱ṇyayī̱rbhāra̍tīrbṛ̱hatī̍rma̱hīḥ pati̱mindra̍ṃ vayo̱dhasa̍m vi̱rāja̱ṃ chanda̍ i̱hendri̱yaṃ dhe̱nuṃ gāṃ na vayo̍ dadha̱dvyantvājya̍sya̱ hota̱ryaja̍
275.d: होता̍ यक्ष̱त्पेश̍स्वतीस्ति̱स्रो दे̱वीर्हि̍र̱ण्ययी̱र्भार̍तीर्बृ̱हती̍र्म̱हीः पति̱मिन्द्र̍ं वयो̱धस̍म् वि̱राज̱ं छन्द̍ इ̱हेन्द्रि̱यं धे̱नुं गां न वयो̍ दध̱द्व्यन्त्वाज्य̍स्य̱ होत̱र्यज̍
275.m:
May the Hotṛ sacrifice to the well-adorned three goddesses, the golden, lofty, great Bhāratīs, to their lord Indra the bestower of vigor,
Bestowing the Virāj metre, manly power here, a milch-cow, vigor. Let them partake of the clarified butter; O Hotṛ, sacrifice!

275.s: hotā̍ yakṣatsu̱reta̍sa̱ṃ tvaṣṭā̍raṃ puṣṭivardha̍nam̐ rū̱pāṇi̱ bibhra̍taṃ pa̱thak puṣṭi̱mindra̍ṃ vayo̱dhasa̍m dvi̱pada̱ṃ chanda̍ indri̱yamu̱kṣāṇa̱ṃ gāṃ na vayo̍ dadha̱dvetvājya̍sya̱ hota̱ryaja̍
275.d: होता̍ यक्षत्सु̱रेत̍स̱ं त्वष्टा̍रं पुष्टिवर्ध̍नम्̐ रू̱पाणि̱ बिभ्र̍तं प̱थक् पुष्टि̱मिन्द्र̍ं वयो̱धस̍म् द्वि̱पद̱ं छन्द̍ इन्द्रि̱यमु̱क्षाण̱ं गां न वयो̍ दध̱द्वेत्वाज्य̍स्य̱ होत̱र्यज̍
275.m:
May the Hotṛ sacrifice to Tvaṣṭṛ of good seed, the increaser of prosperity, bearing forms separately, to prosperity, to Indra the bestower of vigor,
Bestowing the Dvipadā metre, manly power, a bull, vigor. Let him partake of the clarified butter; O Hotṛ, sacrifice!

275.s: hotā̍ yakṣa̱dvana̱spati̍m̐ śami̱tāra̍ṃm̐ śa̱takra̍tum̐ hira̍ṇyaparṇamukthina̍ṃm̐ raśa̱nāṃ bibhra̍taṃ va̱śiṃ bhaga̱mindra̍ṃ vayo̱dhasa̍m ka̱kubha̱ṃ chanda̍ i̱hendri̱yaṃ va̱śāṃ ve̱hata̱ṃ gāṃ vayo̍ dadha̱dvetvājya̍sya̱ hota̱ryaja̍
275.d: होता̍ यक्ष̱द्वन̱स्पति̍म्̐ शमि̱तार̍ंम्̐ श̱तक्र̍तुम्̐ हिर̍ण्यपर्णमुक्थिन̍ंम्̐ रश̱नां बिभ्र̍तं व̱शिं भग̱मिन्द्र̍ं वयो̱धस̍म् क̱कुभ̱ं छन्द̍ इ̱हेन्द्रि̱यं व̱शां वे̱हत̱ं गां वयो̍ दध̱द्वेत्वाज्य̍स्य̱ होत̱र्यज̍
275.m:
May the Hotṛ sacrifice to Vanaspati, the immolator, of a hundred purposes, golden-leaved, possessing hymns, holding the cord, the ruler, to Bhaga, to Indra the bestower of vigor,
Bestowing the Kakubh metre, manly power here, a barren cow, an aborted cow, vigor. Let him partake of the clarified butter; O Hotṛ, sacrifice!

275.s: hotā̍ yakṣa̱tsvāhā̍kṛtīra̱gniṃ gṛ̱hapa̍tiṃ pa̱thagvaru̍ṇaṃ bheṣa̱jaṃ ka̱viṃ kṣa̱tramindra̍ṃ vayo̱dhasa̍m ati̍cchandasa̱ṃ chanda̍ indri̱yaṃ bṛ̱hadṛ̍ṣa̱bhaṃ gāṃ vayo̍ dadha̱dvyantvājya̍sya̱ hota̱ryaja̍ 11(3)34
275.d: होता̍ यक्ष̱त्स्वाहा̍कृतीर̱ग्निं गृ̱हप̍तिं प̱थग्वरु̍णं भेष̱जं क̱विं क्ष̱त्रमिन्द्र̍ं वयो̱धस̍म् अति̍च्छन्दस̱ं छन्द̍ इन्द्रि̱यं बृ̱हदृ̍ष̱भं गां वयो̍ दध̱द्व्यन्त्वाज्य̍स्य̱ होत̱र्यज̍ 11(3)34
275.m:
May the Hotṛ sacrifice to the svāhā-cries, to Agni the lord of the homestead separately, to Varuṇa, the medicine, the sage, to princely power, to Indra the bestower of vigor,
Bestowing the Aticchandas metre, manly power, a mighty bull, vigor. Let them partake of the clarified butter; O Hotṛ, sacrifice!

276.s: de̱vaṃ ba̱rhirva̍yo̱dhasa̍ṃ de̱vamindra̍mavardhayat gā̱ya̱tryā chanda̍sendri̱yaṃ cakṣu̱rindre̱ vayo̱ dadha̍dvasuva̱ne̍ vasudhe̱ya̍sya vetu̱ yaja̍
276.d: दे̱वं ब̱र्हिर्व̍यो̱धस̍ं दे̱वमिन्द्र̍मवर्धयत् गा̱य̱त्र्या छन्द̍सेन्द्रि̱यं चक्षु̱रिन्द्रे̱ वयो̱ दध̍द्वसुव̱ने̍ वसुधे̱य̍स्य वेतु̱ यज̍
276.m:
The divine sacred grass made the bestower of vigor, divine Indra, flourish,
Bestowing with the Gāyatrī metre manly power, sight in Indra, vigor. For the winning of wealth, let it partake of the wealth-store; sacrifice!

276.s: de̱vīrdvā̍ro̍ vayo̱dhasa̍m̐ śuci̱mindra̍mavardhayan u̱ṣṇihā̱ chanda̍sendri̱yaṃ prā̱ṇamindre̱ vayo̱ dadha̍dvasuva̱ne̍ vasudhe̱ya̍sya vyantu̱ yaja̍
276.d: दे̱वीर्द्वा̍रो̍ वयो̱धस̍म्̐ शुचि̱मिन्द्र̍मवर्धयन् उ̱ष्णिहा̱ छन्द̍सेन्द्रि̱यं प्रा̱णमिन्द्रे̱ वयो̱ दध̍द्वसुव̱ने̍ वसुधे̱य̍स्य व्यन्तु̱ यज̍
276.m:
The divine Doors made the bestower of vigor, the pure Indra, flourish,
Bestowing with the Uṣṇih metre manly power, in-breath in Indra, vigor. For the winning of wealth, let them partake of the wealth-store; sacrifice!

276.s: de̱vī u̱ṣāsā̱naktā̍ de̱vamindra̍ṃ vayo̱dhasa̍ṃ de̱vī de̱vama̍vardhatām a̱nu̱ṣṭubhā̱ chanda̍sendri̱yaṃ bala̱mindre̱ vayo̱ dadha̍dvasuva̱ne̍ vasudhe̱ya̍sya vī̱tāṃ yaja̍
276.d: दे̱वी उ̱षासा̱नक्ता̍ दे̱वमिन्द्र̍ं वयो̱धस̍ं दे̱वी दे̱वम̍वर्धताम् अ̱नु̱ष्टुभा̱ छन्द̍सेन्द्रि̱यं बल̱मिन्द्रे̱ वयो̱ दध̍द्वसुव̱ने̍ वसुधे̱य̍स्य वी̱तां यज̍
276.m:
The two divine ones, Dawn and Night, made divine Indra, the bestower of vigor, the two goddesses made the god flourish,
Bestowing with the Anuṣṭubh metre manly power, strength in Indra, vigor. For the winning of wealth, let the two partake of the wealth-store; sacrifice!

276.s: de̱vī joṣṭrī̍ vasu̍dhitī de̱vamindra̍ṃ vayo̱dhasa̍ṃ de̱vī de̱vama̍vardhatām bṛ̱ha̱tyā chanda̍sendri̱yam̐ śrotra̱mindre̱ vayo̱ dadha̍dvasuva̱ne̍ vasudhe̱ya̍sya vī̱tāṃ yaja̍
276.d: दे̱वी जोष्ट्री̍ वसु̍धिती दे̱वमिन्द्र̍ं वयो̱धस̍ं दे̱वी दे̱वम̍वर्धताम् बृ̱ह̱त्या छन्द̍सेन्द्रि̱यम्̐ श्रोत्र̱मिन्द्रे̱ वयो̱ दध̍द्वसुव̱ने̍ वसुधे̱य̍स्य वी̱तां यज̍
276.m:
The two divine goddesses, approving, wealth-bestowing, made divine Indra, the bestower of vigor, the two goddesses made the god flourish,
Bestowing with the Bṛhatī metre manly power, hearing in Indra, vigor. For the winning of wealth, let the two partake of the wealth-store; sacrifice!

276.s: de̱vī ū̱rjāhu̍tī du̱ghe̍ su̱dughe̍ paya̱sendra̍ṃ vayo̱dhasa̍ṃ de̱vī de̱vama̍vardhatām pa̱ṅktyā chanda̍sendri̱yam̐ śu̱kramindre̱ vayo̱ dadha̍dvasuva̱ne̍ vasudhe̱ya̍sya vī̱tāṃ yaja̍
276.d: दे̱वी ऊ̱र्जाहु̍ती दु̱घे̍ सु̱दुघे̍ पय̱सेन्द्र̍ं वयो̱धस̍ं दे̱वी दे̱वम̍वर्धताम् प̱ङ्क्त्या छन्द̍सेन्द्रि̱यम्̐ शु̱क्रमिन्द्रे̱ वयो̱ दध̍द्वसुव̱ने̍ वसुधे̱य̍स्य वी̱तां यज̍
276.m:
The two divine invocations of vigor, milch-cows, yielding well with milk, made Indra, the bestower of vigor, the two goddesses made the god flourish,
Bestowing with the Paṅkti metre manly power, bright seed in Indra, vigor. For the winning of wealth, let the two partake of the wealth-store; sacrifice!

276.s: de̱vā daivyā̱ hotā̍rā de̱vamindra̍ṃ vayo̱dhasa̍ṃ de̱vau de̱vama̍vardhatām tri̱ṣṭubhā̱ chanda̍sendri̱yaṃ tviṣi̱mindre̱ vayo̱ dadha̍dvasuva̱ne̍ vasudhe̱ya̍sya vī̱tāṃ yaja̍
276.d: दे̱वा दैव्या̱ होता̍रा दे̱वमिन्द्र̍ं वयो̱धस̍ं दे̱वौ दे̱वम̍वर्धताम् त्रि̱ष्टुभा̱ छन्द̍सेन्द्रि̱यं त्विषि̱मिन्द्रे̱ वयो̱ दध̍द्वसुव̱ने̍ वसुधे̱य̍स्य वी̱तां यज̍
276.m:
The two divine Hotṛs made divine Indra, the bestower of vigor, the two gods made the god flourish,
Bestowing with the Triṣṭubh metre manly power, brilliance in Indra, vigor. For the winning of wealth, let the two partake of the wealth-store; sacrifice!

276.s: de̱vīsti̱srasti̱sro de̱vīrva̍yo̱dhasa̱ṃ pati̱mindra̍mavardhayan jaga̍tyā̱ chanda̍sendri̱yam̐ śūṣa̱mindre̱ vayo̱ dadha̍dvasuva̱ne̍ vasudhe̱ya̍sya vyantu̱ yaja̍
276.d: दे̱वीस्ति̱स्रस्ति̱स्रो दे̱वीर्व̍यो̱धस̱ं पति̱मिन्द्र̍मवर्धयन् जग̍त्या̱ छन्द̍सेन्द्रि̱यम्̐ शूष̱मिन्द्रे̱ वयो̱ दध̍द्वसुव̱ने̍ वसुधे̱य̍स्य व्यन्तु̱ यज̍
276.m:
The three divine goddesses made their lord Indra, the bestower of vigor, flourish,
Bestowing with the Jagatī metre manly power, impetuous strength in Indra, vigor. For the winning of wealth, let them partake of the wealth-store; sacrifice!

276.s: de̱vo narā̱śam̐so̍ de̱vamindra̍ṃ vayo̱dhasa̍ṃ de̱vo de̱vama̍vardhayat vi̱rājā̱ chanda̍sendri̱yam̐ rū̱pamindre̱ vayo̱ dadha̍dvasuva̱ne̍ vasudhe̱ya̍sya vetu̱ yaja̍
276.d: दे̱वो नरा̱शम्̐सो̍ दे̱वमिन्द्र̍ं वयो̱धस̍ं दे̱वो दे̱वम̍वर्धयत् वि̱राजा̱ छन्द̍सेन्द्रि̱यम्̐ रू̱पमिन्द्रे̱ वयो̱ दध̍द्वसुव̱ने̍ वसुधे̱य̍स्य वेतु̱ यज̍
276.m: The divine Narāśaṃsa [strengthened] the divine Indra, the granter of vitality; the god strengthened the god. / Placing bodily power and beauty in Indra with the virāj metre, conferring vitality, let him partake of the wealth-giving [oblation] for the winning of wealth! Sacrifice!

276.s: de̱vo vana̱spati̍rde̱vamindra̍ṃ vayo̱dhasa̍ṃ de̱vo de̱vama̍vardhayat dvi̱padā̱ chanda̍sendri̱yaṃ bhaga̱mindre̱ vayo̱ dadha̍dvasuva̱ne̍ vasudhe̱ya̍sya vetu̱ yaja̍
276.d: दे̱वो वन̱स्पति̍र्दे̱वमिन्द्र̍ं वयो̱धस̍ं दे̱वो दे̱वम̍वर्धयत् द्वि̱पदा̱ छन्द̍सेन्द्रि̱यं भग̱मिन्द्रे̱ वयो̱ दध̍द्वसुव̱ने̍ वसुधे̱य̍स्य वेतु̱ यज̍
276.m: The divine Lord of the Forest [strengthened] the divine Indra, the granter of vitality; the god strengthened the god. / Placing bodily power and fortune in Indra with the dvipadā metre, conferring vitality, let him partake of the wealth-giving [oblation] for the winning of wealth! Sacrifice!

276.s: de̱vaṃ ba̱rhirvā̍ri̍tīnāṃ de̱vamindra̍ṃ vayo̱dhasa̍ṃ de̱vaṃ de̱vama̍vardhayat ka̱kubhā̱ chanda̍sendri̱yaṃ yaśa̱ indre̱ vayo̱ dadha̍dvasuva̱ne̍ vasudhe̱ya̍sya vetu̱ yaja̍
276.d: दे̱वं ब̱र्हिर्वा̍रि̍तीनां दे̱वमिन्द्र̍ं वयो̱धस̍ं दे̱वं दे̱वम̍वर्धयत् क̱कुभा̱ छन्द̍सेन्द्रि̱यं यश̱ इन्द्रे̱ वयो̱ दध̍द्वसुव̱ने̍ वसुधे̱य̍स्य वेतु̱ यज̍
276.m: The divine sacrificial grass of the streams [strengthened] the divine Indra, the granter of vitality; the god strengthened the god. / Placing bodily power and glory in Indra with the kakubh metre, conferring vitality, let him partake of the wealth-giving [oblation] for the winning of wealth! Sacrifice!

276.s: de̱vo a̱gniḥ sviṣṭa̱kṛdde̱vamindra̍ṃ vayo̱dhasa̍ṃ de̱vo de̱vama̍vardhayat ati̍cchandasā̱ chanda̍sendri̱yaṃ kṣa̱tramindre̱ vayo̱ dadha̍dvasuva̱ne̍ vasudhe̱ya̍sya vetu̱ yaja̍
276.d: दे̱वो अ̱ग्निः स्विष्ट̱कृद्दे̱वमिन्द्र̍ं वयो̱धस̍ं दे̱वो दे̱वम̍वर्धयत् अति̍च्छन्दसा̱ छन्द̍सेन्द्रि̱यं क्ष̱त्रमिन्द्रे̱ वयो̱ दध̍द्वसुव̱ने̍ वसुधे̱य̍स्य वेतु̱ यज̍
276.m: The divine Agni Sviṣṭakṛt strengthened the divine Indra, the granter of vitality; the god strengthened the god. / Placing bodily power and princely power in Indra with the aticchandas metre, conferring vitality, let him partake of the wealth-giving [oblation] for the winning of wealth! Sacrifice!

276.s: a̱gnima̱dya hotā̍ramavṛṇītā̱yaṃ yaja̍mānaḥ paca̱npaktīḥ paca̍npuro̱ḍāśa̍ṃ ba̱dhnannindrā̍ya vayo̱dhase̱ chāga̍m sūpa̱sthā a̱dya de̱vo vana̱spati̍rabhava̱dindrā̍ya vayo̱dhase̱ chāge̍na agha̍tta̱ meda̍staḥ prati̍paca̱tāgra̍bhīdavī̍vṛdhatpuro̱ḍāśe̍na | tvāma̱dya ṛ̍ṣe
276.d: अ̱ग्निम̱द्य होता̍रमवृणीता̱यं यज̍मानः पच̱न्पक्तीः पच̍न्पुरो̱डाश̍ं ब̱ध्नन्निन्द्रा̍य वयो̱धसे̱ छाग̍म् सूप̱स्था अ̱द्य दे̱वो वन̱स्पति̍रभव̱दिन्द्रा̍य वयो̱धसे̱ छागे̍न अघ̍त्त̱ मेद̍स्तः प्रति̍पच̱ताग्र̍भीदवी̍वृधत्पुरो̱डाशे̍न । त्वाम̱द्य ऋ̍षे
276.m: Agni has this sacrificer chosen today as Hotṛ, cooking the cooked offerings, cooking the sacrificial cake, binding the he-goat for Indra the granter of vitality. / A good standing-place today became the divine Lord of the Forest for Indra the granter of vitality with the he-goat. / He ate of the fat; from the cooked [meat] he received it; he made [Indra] thrive with the sacrificial cake. You today, O ṛṣi!

276.s:
(4)
hotā yakṣadekādaśa
devaṃ barhirdvādaśa
hotā yakṣadekādaśa
devaṃ barhirdvādaśa
caturanuvākeṣu ṣaṭcatvāriṃśat
atha caturtho daśakaḥ
276.d:
(4)
होता यक्षदेकादश
देवं बर्हिर्द्वादश
होता यक्षदेकादश
देवं बर्हिर्द्वादश
चतुरनुवाकेषु षट्चत्वारिंशत्
अथ चतुर्थो दशकः
276.m: “Let the Hotṛ sacrifice”: eleven. “The divine sacrificial grass”: twelve. “Let the Hotṛ sacrifice”: eleven. “The divine sacrificial grass”: twelve. / In the four anuvākas, forty-six. / Thus ends the thirtieth adhyāya in the Śukla Yajurveda Kāṇva Saṃhitā.

277.s: sami̍ddho a̱ñjankṛ̱dara̍ṃ matī̱nāṃ ghṛ̱tama̍gne̱ madhu̍ma̱tpinva̍mānaḥ vā̱jī vaha̍nvā̱jina̍ṃ jātavedo de̱vānā̍ṃ vakṣi pri̱yamā sa̱dhastha̍m
277.d: समि̍द्धो अ̱ञ्जन्कृ̱दर̍ं मती̱नां घृ̱तम̍ग्ने̱ मधु̍म̱त्पिन्व̍मानः वा̱जी वह̍न्वा̱जिन̍ं जातवेदो दे̱वाना̍ं वक्षि प्रि̱यमा स̱धस्थ̍म्
277.m: Kindled, anointing the chamber of the prayers, brimming with sweet butter, O Agni, / a courser bearing the courser, O Jātavedas, carry [him] to the dear assembly of the gods!

277.s: ghṛ̱tenā̱ñjantsaṃ pa̱tho de̍va̱yānā̍nprajā̱nanvā̱jyapye̍tu de̱vān anu̍ tvā sapte pra̱diśa̍ḥ sacantā̱m̐ sva̱dhāma̱smai yaja̍mānāya dhehi
277.d: घृ̱तेना̱ञ्जन्त्सं प̱थो दे̍व̱याना̍न्प्रजा̱नन्वा̱ज्यप्ये̍तु दे̱वान् अनु̍ त्वा सप्ते प्र̱दिश̍ः सचन्ता̱म्̐ स्व̱धाम̱स्मै यज̍मानाय धेहि
277.m: Anointing the paths of the gods with clarified butter, knowing them, let the courser go to the gods. / Let the quarters attend you, O steed; bestow svadhā upon this sacrificer!

277.s: īḍya̍ścāsi vandya̍śca vāji̱nnāśuścā̍si me̱dhya̍śca sapte a̱gniṣṭvāṃ de̱vairvasu̍bhiḥ sa̱joṣā̍ḥ prī̱taṃ vahni̍ṃ vahatu jā̱tave̍dāḥ
277.d: ईड्य̍श्चासि वन्द्य̍श्च वाजि̱न्नाशुश्चा̍सि मे̱ध्य̍श्च सप्ते अ̱ग्निष्ट्वां दे̱वैर्वसु̍भिः स̱जोषा̍ः प्री̱तं वह्नि̍ं वहतु जा̱तवे̍दाः
277.m: You are worthy of praise and homage, O courser; you are swift and sacrificial, O steed. / Let Agni Jātavedas, joyful in concord with the divine Vasus, carry the pleased mount!

277.s: stī̱rṇaṃ ba̱rhiḥ suṣṭa̍rīmā juṣā̱ṇoru pṛ̱thu pratha̍mānaṃ pṛthi̱vyām de̱vebhi̍ryu̱ktamadi̍tiḥ sa̱joṣā̍ḥ syo̱naṃ kṛ̍ṇvānā su̱vite da̍dhātu
277.d: स्ती̱र्णं ब̱र्हिः सुष्ट̍रीमा जुषा̱णोरु पृ̱थु प्रथ̍मानं पृथि̱व्याम् दे̱वेभि̍र्यु̱क्तमदि̍तिः स̱जोषा̍ः स्यो̱नं कृ̍ण्वाना सु̱विते द̍धातु
277.m: Pleasing, spread broad and wide across the earth, the well-strewn sacrificial grass, / prepared with the gods, let Aditi, rejoicing in concord, establish in comfort for our welfare!

277.s: e̱tā u̍ vaḥ su̱bhagā̍ vi̱śvarū̍pā vi pa̱kṣobhi̍ḥ śraya̍māṇā udā̱taiḥ ṛ̱ṣvāḥ sa̱tīḥ ka̱vaṣa̍ḥ śumbha̍mānā̱ dvāro̍ de̱vīḥ su̍prāya̱ṇā bha̍vantu
277.d: ए̱ता उ̍ वः सु̱भगा̍ वि̱श्वरू̍पा वि प̱क्षोभि̍ः श्रय̍माणा उदा̱तैः ऋ̱ष्वाः स̱तीः क̱वष̍ः शुम्भ̍माना̱ द्वारो̍ दे̱वीः सु̍प्राय̱णा भ̍वन्तु
277.m: These fortunate ones of all forms, unclosing with their widespread wings, / lofty, well-fitting, adorned, let the divine doors be easy of approach!

277.s: a̱ntarā mi̱trāvaru̍ṇā cara̍ntī̱ mukha̍ṃ ya̱jñānā̍ma̱bhi sa̱ṃvidā̱ne u̱ṣāsā̱ vām̐ su̱hira̍ṇye su̱śilpe ṛ̱tasya̱ yonā̍ i̱ha sā̍dayāmi
277.d: अ̱न्तरा मि̱त्रावरु̍णा चर̍न्ती̱ मुख̍ं य̱ज्ञाना̍म̱भि स̱ंविदा̱ने उ̱षासा̱ वाम्̐ सु̱हिर̍ण्ये सु̱शिल्पे ऋ̱तस्य̱ योना̍ इ̱ह सा̍दयामि
277.m: Moving between Mitra and Varuṇa, knowing together the face of the sacrifices, / rich in gold, well-adorned Night and Dawn, I seat you here in the womb of truth!

277.s: pratha̱mā vā̱ṃm̐ sara̍thināṃ su̱varṇā̍ de̱vau paśya̍ntau̱ bhuva̍nāni̱ viśvā̍ a̱rpipra̱yaṃ coda̍nā vāṃ mimā̍nā hotā̍rā̱ jyoti̍ḥ pra̱diśo̍ diśantā̍
277.d: प्रथ̱मा वा̱ंम्̐ सर̍थिनां सु̱वर्णा̍ दे̱वौ पश्य̍न्तौ̱ भुव̍नानि̱ विश्वा̍ अ̱र्पिप्र̱यं चोद̍ना वां मिमा̍ना होता̍रा̱ ज्योति̍ः प्र̱दिशो̍ दिशन्ता̍
277.m: The two first charioteers, of golden color, the two gods beholding all beings, / measuring your inspirations, the two Hotṛs displaying the light in direction, have I pleased!

277.s: ā̱di̱tyairno̱ bhāra̍tī vaṣṭu ya̱jñam̐ sara̍svatī sa̱ha ru̱drairna̍ āvīt iḷopa̍hūtā̱ vasu̍bhiḥ sa̱joṣā̍ ya̱jña no̍ de̱vīr‌mṛ̱teṣu̍ dhatta
277.d: आ̱दि̱त्यैर्नो̱ भार̍ती वष्टु य̱ज्ञम्̐ सर̍स्वती स̱ह रु̱द्रैर्न̍ आवीत् इऌओप̍हूता̱ वसु̍भिः स̱जोषा̍ य̱ज्ञ नो̍ दे̱वीर्‌मृ̱तेषु̍ धत्त
277.m: Let Bhāratī along with the Ādityas desire our sacrifice; let Sarasvatī along with the Rudras favor us; / invoked, Iḷā in concord with the Vasus—place our sacrifice among the immortals, O goddesses!

277.s: tvaṣṭā̍ vī̱raṃ de̍vakā̱maṃ ja̍jāna̱ tvaṣṭu̍rarvā̍ jāyata ā̱śuraśva̍ḥ tvaṣṭe̱daṃ viśva̱ṃ bhuva̍naṃ jajāna ba̱hoḥ ka̱rtāra̍mi̱ha ya̍kṣi hotataḥ
277.d: त्वष्टा̍ वी̱रं दे̍वका̱मं ज̍जान̱ त्वष्टु̍रर्वा̍ जायत आ̱शुरश्व̍ः त्वष्टे̱दं विश्व̱ं भुव̍नं जजान ब̱होः क̱र्तार̍मि̱ह य̍क्षि होततः
277.m: Tvaṣṭṛ begot the hero who loves the gods; from Tvaṣṭṛ was born the swift horse, the courser. / Tvaṣṭṛ begot this entire creation: sacrifice here, O Hotṛ, to the maker of much!

277.s: aśvo̍ ghṛ̱tena̱ tmanyā sama̍kta̱ upa̍ de̱vām̐2 ṛ̍tu̱śaḥ pātha̍ etu vana̱spati̍rde̱valo̱kaṃ pra̍jā̱nanna̱gninā̍ ha̱vyā sva̍di̱tāni̍ vakṣat
277.d: अश्वो̍ घृ̱तेन̱ त्मन्या सम̍क्त̱ उप̍ दे̱वाम्̐2 ऋ̍तु̱शः पाथ̍ एतु वन̱स्पति̍र्दे̱वलो̱कं प्र̍जा̱नन्न̱ग्निना̍ ह̱व्या स्व̍दि̱तानि̍ वक्षत्
277.m: May the horse, well anointed by itself with clarified butter, go according to seasons to the abode of the gods! / May the Lord of the Forest, knowing the world of the gods, convey the offerings made savory with Agni!

277.s: pra̱jāpa̍testapa̍sā vāvṛdhā̱naḥ sa̱dyo jā̱to da̍dhiṣe ya̱jñama̍gne svāhā̍kṛtena ha̱viṣā̍ purogā yā̱hi sā̱dhyā ha̱vira̍dantu de̱vāḥ
277.d: प्र̱जाप̍तेस्तप̍सा वावृधा̱नः स̱द्यो जा̱तो द̍धिषे य̱ज्ञम̍ग्ने स्वाहा̍कृतेन ह̱विषा̍ पुरोगा या̱हि सा̱ध्या ह̱विर̍दन्तु दे̱वाः
277.m: Grown strong through the ascetic heat of Prajāpati, born immediately, you have undertaken the sacrifice, O Agni! / With the oblation made with svāhā go in front; let the Sādhya gods eat the oblation!

278.s: (1) ke̱tuṃ kṛ̱ṇvanna̍ke̱tave̱ peśo̍ maryā ape̱śase̍ | samu̱ṣadbhi̍rajāyathāḥ
278.d: (1) के̱तुं कृ̱ण्वन्न̍के̱तवे̱ पेशो̍ मर्या अपे̱शसे̍ । समु̱षद्भि̍रजायथाः
278.m: Giving a banner to that which had no banner, form to the formless, O mortal men, you were born together with the dawns!

278.s: jī̱mūta̍syeva bhavati̱ pratī̍ka̱ṃ yadva̱rmī yāti̍ sa̱madā̍mu̱pasthe̍ anā̍viddhayā ta̱nvā̍ jaya̱ tvam̐ sa tvā̱ varma̍ṇo mahi̱mā pi̍partu
278.d: जी̱मूत̍स्येव भवति̱ प्रती̍क̱ं यद्व̱र्मी याति̍ स̱मदा̍मु̱पस्थे̍ अना̍विद्धया त̱न्वा̍ जय̱ त्वम्̐ स त्वा̱ वर्म̍णो महि̱मा पि̍पर्तु
278.m: Like the surface of a cloud is his appearance when the armored man goes into the lap of battles. / Win with an unpierced body! Let the greatness of your armor protect you!

278.s: dhanva̍nā gā dhanva̍nā̱jiṃ ja̍yema̱ dhanva̍nā tī̱vrāḥ samado̍ jayema dhanuḥ śatro̍rapakā̱maṃ kṛ̍ṇoti̱ dhanva̍nā̱ sarvā̍ḥ pra̱diśo̍ jayema
278.d: धन्व̍ना गा धन्व̍ना̱जिं ज̍येम̱ धन्व̍ना ती̱व्राः समदो̍ जयेम धनुः शत्रो̍रपका̱मं कृ̍णोति̱ धन्व̍ना̱ सर्वा̍ः प्र̱दिशो̍ जयेम
278.m: With the bow may we win cattle, with the bow win the race; with the bow may we win fierce battles! / The bow thwarts the wish of the enemy; with the bow may we win all quarters!

278.s: te āca̍rantī sama̱neva̱ yoṣā̍ mā̱teva̍ pu̱traṃ bi̍bhṛtāmu̱pasthe̍ apa̱ śatrū̍nvidhyatā̱m̐ saṃvidā̱ne ārnī̍ i̱me vi̍ṣphurantī̍ a̱mitrān̍
278.d: ते आच̍रन्ती सम̱नेव̱ योषा̍ मा̱तेव̍ पु̱त्रं बि̍भृतामु̱पस्थे̍ अप̱ शत्रू̍न्विध्यता̱म्̐ संविदा̱ने आर्नी̍ इ̱मे वि̍ष्फुरन्ती̍ अ̱मित्रान्̍
278.m: Approaching like two women at a meeting, like a mother may they hold [the arrow] in their lap! / Piercing the enemies, harmonious, let these two bow-ends snap against our foes!

278.s: va̱kṣyantīvedā ga̍nīganti̱ karṇa̍ṃ pri̱yam̐ sakhā̍yaṃ pariṣasvajā̱nā yoṣe̍va śiṅkte vitatādhi dhanvan jyā iyam̐ sama̍ne pā̱raya̍ntī
278.d: व̱क्ष्यन्तीवेदा ग̍नीगन्ति̱ कर्ण̍ं प्रि̱यम्̐ सखा̍यं परिषस्वजा̱ना योषे̍व शिङ्क्ते वितताधि धन्वन् ज्या इयम्̐ सम̍ने पा̱रय̍न्ती
278.m: As if about to speak, she approaches the ear, embracing her beloved friend; / like a woman she hums, stretched taut upon the bow, this bowstring that carries us across in battle!

278.s: ahi̍riva bho̱gaiḥ paryai̍ti bā̱huṃ jyāyā̍ he̱tiṃ pa̍ribādha̍mānaḥ ha̱sta̱ghno viśvā̍ va̱yunā̍ni vi̱dvānpumā̱npumā̍m̐saṃ pari̍ pātu vi̱śvata̍ḥ
278.d: अहि̍रिव भो̱गैः पर्यै̍ति बा̱हुं ज्याया̍ हे̱तिं प̍रिबाध̍मानः ह̱स्त̱घ्नो विश्वा̍ व̱युना̍नि वि̱द्वान्पुमा̱न्पुमा̍म्̐सं परि̍ पातु वि̱श्वत̍ः
278.m: Like a serpent with its coils it encircles the arm, warding off the stroke of the bowstring: / knowing all artifices, let the hand-guard, manly, protect the man on every side!

278.s: ba̱hvīnā̍ṃ pi̱tā ba̱hura̍sya pu̱traściśvā kṛ̍ṇoti sama̱nāva̱gatya̍ i̱ṣu̱dhiḥ saṅkāḥ pṛta̍nāśca̱ sarvā̍ḥ pṛ̱ṣṭhe nina̍ddho jayati̱ prasūta̍ḥ
278.d: ब̱ह्वीना̍ं पि̱ता ब̱हुर̍स्य पु̱त्रश्चिश्वा कृ̍णोति सम̱नाव̱गत्य̍ इ̱षु̱धिः सङ्काः पृत̍नाश्च̱ सर्वा̍ः पृ̱ष्ठे निन̍द्धो जयति̱ प्रसूत̍ः
278.m: Father of many, whose sons are many, he clatters as he goes into the conflicts: / the quiver, fastened on the back, discharged, wins all clashes and all armies!

278.s: supa̱rṇaṃ va̍ste mṛ̱go a̍syā danto̱ gobhi̱ḥ saṃna̍ddhā patati̱ prasū̍tā yatrā̱ nara̱ḥ saṃ ca̱ vi ca̱ drava̍nti̱ tatrā̱smabhya̱miṣa̍va̱ḥ śarma̍ yam̐san
278.d: सुप̱र्णं व̍स्ते मृ̱गो अ̍स्या दन्तो̱ गोभि̱ः संन̍द्धा पतति̱ प्रसू̍ता यत्रा̱ नर̱ः सं च̱ वि च̱ द्रव̍न्ति̱ तत्रा̱स्मभ्य̱मिष̍व̱ः शर्म̍ यम्̐सन्
278.m: Clothed in fine feathers, its tooth is deer-horn, bound with sinews: discharged, it flies! / Where men run together and fly apart, there let the arrows grant us protection!

278.s: vana̍spate vī̱ḍva̍ṅgo hi bhū̱yā a̱smatsa̍khā pra̱tara̍ṇaḥ su̱vīra̍ḥ gobhi̱ḥ saṃna̍ddho asi vī̱ḷaya̍svāsthātā te̍ jayatu jetvā̍ni
278.d: वन̍स्पते वी̱ड्व̍ङ्गो हि भू̱या अ̱स्मत्स̍खा प्र̱तर̍णः सु̱वीर̍ः गोभि̱ः संन̍द्धो असि वी̱ऌअय̍स्वास्थाता ते̍ जयतु जेत्वा̍नि
278.m: O Lord of the Forest, be of strong limbs, our friend that carries us across, rich in heroes! / Bound with sinews are you: make yourself stout! Let your rider win what is to be won!

278.s: rathe̱ tiṣṭha̍nnayati vā̱jina̍ḥ pu̱ro yatra̍yatra̱ kāmaya̍te suṣā̱rathiḥ a̱bhīśū̍nāṃ mahi̱māna̍ṃ panāyata̱ mana̍ḥ pa̱ścādanu̍ yacchanti ra̱śmaya̍ḥ
278.d: रथे̱ तिष्ठ̍न्नयति वा̱जिन̍ः पु̱रो यत्र̍यत्र̱ कामय̍ते सुषा̱रथिः अ̱भीशू̍नां महि̱मान̍ं पनायत̱ मन̍ः प̱श्चादनु̍ यच्छन्ति र̱श्मय̍ः
278.m: Standing on the chariot, the good charioteer drives the coursers ahead wherever he desires. / Extol the greatness of the reins: behind, the traces follow his mind!

278.s: ā ja̍ṅghanti̱ sānve̍ṣāṃ ja̱ghanā̍m̐2 upa̍ jighnate aśvā̍jani prace̍taso'śvā̍ntsama̱tsu̍ codaya
278.d: आ ज̍ङ्घन्ति̱ सान्वे̍षां ज̱घना̍म्̐2 उप̍ जिघ्नते अश्वा̍जनि प्रचे̍तसोऽश्वा̍न्त्सम̱त्सु̍ चोदय
278.m: They strike their haunches, they hit their rumps; / O horse-whip, urge in battles the horses that understand!

278.s: upa̍ śvāsaya pṛthi̱vīmu̱ta dyāṃ pu̍ru̱trā te̍ manutāṃ viṣṭhi̍ta̱ṃ jaga̍t sa du̍ndubhe sa̱jūrindre̍ṇa de̱vairdūrāddavī̍yo̱ apa̍ sedha̱ śatrū̍n
278.d: उप̍ श्वासय पृथि̱वीमु̱त द्यां पु̍रु̱त्रा ते̍ मनुतां विष्ठि̍त̱ं जग̍त् स दु̍न्दुभे स̱जूरिन्द्रे̍ण दे̱वैर्दूराद्दवी̍यो̱ अप̍ सेध̱ शत्रू̍न्
278.m: Resound unto the earth and unto heaven; let the world spread far and wide recognize you! / O war-drum, united with Indra and the gods, drive the enemies away, further than far!

279.s: (2) yadakra̍ndaḥ pratha̱maṃ jāya̍māna u̱dyantsa̍mu̱drādu̱ta vā̱ purī̍ṣāt śye̱nasya̍ pa̱kṣā ha̍ri̱ṇasya̍ bā̱hū u̍pa̱stutya̍ṃ ma̱hi jā̱taṃ te̍ arvan
279.d: (2) यदक्र̍न्दः प्रथ̱मं जाय̍मान उ̱द्यन्त्स̍मु̱द्रादु̱त वा̱ पुरी̍षात् श्ये̱नस्य̍ प̱क्षा ह̍रि̱णस्य̍ बा̱हू उ̍प̱स्तुत्य̍ं म̱हि जा̱तं ते̍ अर्वन्
279.m:
When first being born you neighed, rising from the sea or from the moist depths,
you had the wings of the falcon, the forelegs of the gazelle; your high birth, o steed, is worthy of praise.

279.s: ya̱mena̍ da̱ttaṃ tri̱ta e̍namāyuna̱gindra̍ eṇaṃ pratha̱mo adhya̍tiṣṭhat ga̱ndha̱rvo a̍sya raśa̱nāma̍gṛbhṇā̱tsūrā̱daśva̍ṃ vasavo̱ nira̍taṣṭa
279.d: य̱मेन̍ द̱त्तं त्रि̱त ए̍नमायुन̱गिन्द्र̍ एणं प्रथ̱मो अध्य̍तिष्ठत् ग̱न्ध̱र्वो अ̍स्य रश̱नाम̍गृभ्णा̱त्सूरा̱दश्व̍ं वसवो̱ निर̍तष्ट
279.m:
Yama gave him, Trita harnessed him, Indra was the first to mount him;
the Gandharva grasped his halter; from the sun, o Vasus, you fashioned the horse.

279.s: asi̍ ya̱mo asyā̍di̱tyo a̍rva̱nnasi̍ tri̱to guhye̍na vra̱tena̍ asi̱ some̍na sa̱mayā̱ vipṛ̍kta ā̱huste̱ trīṇi̍ di̱vi bandha̍nāni
279.d: असि̍ य̱मो अस्या̍दि̱त्यो अ̍र्व̱न्नसि̍ त्रि̱तो गुह्ये̍न व्र̱तेन̍ असि̱ सोमे̍न स̱मया̱ विपृ̍क्त आ̱हुस्ते̱ त्रीणि̍ दि̱वि बन्ध̍नानि
279.m:
You are Yama, you are Āditya, o steed; you are Trita by secret commandment;
you are completely separated by Soma; they speak of three bonds for you in heaven.

279.s: trīṇi̍ ta āhurdi̱vi bandha̍nāni̱ trīṇya̱psu trīṇya̱ntaḥ sa̍mu̱dre u̱teva̍ me̱ varu̍ṇaśchantsyarva̱nyatrā̍ ta āhuḥ pa̍ra̱maṃ ja̱nitra̍m
279.d: त्रीणि̍ त आहुर्दि̱वि बन्ध̍नानि̱ त्रीण्य̱प्सु त्रीण्य̱न्तः स̍मु̱द्रे उ̱तेव̍ मे̱ वरु̍णश्छन्त्स्यर्व̱न्यत्रा̍ त आहुः प̍र̱मं ज̱नित्र̍म्
279.m:
Three bonds, they say, are yours in heaven, three in the waters, three within the sea;
and like Varuṇa you seem to me, o steed, where they say your supreme birthplace is.

279.s: i̱mā te̍ vājinnava̱mārja̍nānī̱mā śa̱phānā̍ṃ sani̱turnidhā̍nā atrā̍ te bha̱drā ra̍śa̱nā a̍paśyamṛ̱tasya̱ yā a̍bhirakṣa̍nti go̱pāḥ
279.d: इ̱मा ते̍ वाजिन्नव̱मार्ज̍नानी̱मा श̱फाना̍ं सनि̱तुर्निधा̍ना अत्रा̍ ते भ̱द्रा र̍श̱ना अ̍पश्यमृ̱तस्य̱ या अ̍भिरक्ष̍न्ति गो̱पाः
279.m:
These are your cleansing-places, o swift racer; these the footprints of your hoofs as you win;
here I have seen your auspicious halters, which the herdsmen of truth protect.

279.s: ā̱tmāne̍ te̱ mana̍sārāda̍jānāma̱vo di̱vā pa̍taya̍ntaṃ pata̱ṅgam śiro̍ apaśyaṃ pa̱thibhi̍ḥ su̱gebhi̍rare̱ṇubhi̱rjeha̍mānaṃ pata̱tri
279.d: आ̱त्माने̍ ते̱ मन̍साराद̍जानाम̱वो दि̱वा प̍तय̍न्तं पत̱ङ्गम् शिरो̍ अपश्यं प̱थिभि̍ः सु̱गेभि̍ररे̱णुभि̱र्जेह̍मानं पत̱त्रि
279.m:
Your Self I recognized from afar in spirit: a bird flying down from heaven;
I saw your head fluttering on easy paths, free from dust, winged.

279.s: atrā̍ te rū̱pamu̍tta̱mama̍paśya̱ṃ jigī̍ṣamāṇami̱ṣa ā pa̱de goḥ ya̱dā te̱ marto̱ anu̱ bhoga̱māna̱ḷādid grasi̍ṣṭa̱ oṣa̍dhīrajīgaḥ
279.d: अत्रा̍ ते रू̱पमु̍त्त̱मम̍पश्य̱ं जिगी̍षमाणमि̱ष आ प̱दे गोः य̱दा ते̱ मर्तो̱ अनु̱ भोग̱मान̱ऌआदिद् ग्रसि̍ष्ट̱ ओष̍धीरजीगः
279.m:
Here I saw your highest form, striving to win refreshment in the place of the cow;
when a mortal approached you for enjoyment, then indeed, greedy eater, you tasted the plants.

279.s: anu̍ tvā̱ ratho̱ anu̱ maryo̍ arva̱nnanu̱ gāvo'nu̱ bhaga̍ḥ ka̱nīnā̍m anu̱ vrātā̍sa̱stava̍ sa̱khyamī̍yu̱ranu̍ de̱vā ma̍mire vī̱rya̍ṃ te
279.d: अनु̍ त्वा̱ रथो̱ अनु̱ मर्यो̍ अर्व̱न्ननु̱ गावोऽनु̱ भग̍ः क̱नीना̍म् अनु̱ व्राता̍स̱स्तव̍ स̱ख्यमी̍यु̱रनु̍ दे̱वा म̍मिरे वी̱र्य̍ं ते
279.m:
After you the chariot goes, after you the young man, o steed; after you the cows, after you the favor of maidens;
after you troops have sought your friendship; the gods measured your heroic power.

279.s: hira̍ṇyaśṛṅgo'yo̍ asya̱ pādā̱ mano̍javā̱ avara̱ indra̍ āsīt de̱vā ida̍sya havi̱radya̍māya̱nyo arva̍ntaṃ pratha̱mo a̱dhyati̍ṣṭhat
279.d: हिर̍ण्यशृङ्गोऽयो̍ अस्य̱ पादा̱ मनो̍जवा̱ अवर̱ इन्द्र̍ आसीत् दे̱वा इद̍स्य हवि̱रद्य̍माय̱न्यो अर्व̍न्तं प्रथ̱मो अ̱ध्यति̍ष्ठत्
279.m:
Golden-horned, of iron his feet, swift as thought, he was inferior to Indra;
the gods came to his oblation who was the first to mount the steed.

279.s: ī̱rmāntā̍sa̱ḥ sili̍kamadhyamāsa̱ḥ saṃ śūra̍ṇāso di̱vyāso̱ atyā̍ḥ ha̱ṃsā i̍va śreṇi̱śo ya̍tante̱ yadākṣi̍ṣurdi̱vyamajma̱maśvā̍ḥ
279.d: ई̱र्मान्ता̍स̱ः सिलि̍कमध्यमास̱ः सं शूर̍णासो दि̱व्यासो̱ अत्या̍ः ह̱ंसा इ̍व श्रेणि̱शो य̍तन्ते̱ यदाक्षि̍षुर्दि̱व्यमज्म̱मश्वा̍ः
279.m:
Full-flanked, slender-waisted, vigorous divine coursers,
they flock in rows like geese, when the horses have reached the heavenly racecourse.

279.s: tava̱ śarī̍raṃ patayi̱ṣṇva̍rva̱ntava̍ ci̱ttaṃ vāta̍ iva̱ dhrajī̍mān tava̱ śṛṅgā̍ṇi viṣṭhi̍tā puru̱trāra̍ṇyeṣu jarbhu̍rāṇā caranti
279.d: तव̱ शरी̍रं पतयि̱ष्ण्व̍र्व̱न्तव̍ चि̱त्तं वात̍ इव̱ ध्रजी̍मान् तव̱ शृङ्गा̍णि विष्ठि̍ता पुरु̱त्रार̍ण्येषु जर्भु̍राणा चरन्ति
279.m:
Your body is winged, o steed; your spirit rushes like the wind;
your horns, scattered in many directions, roam darting in the forests.

279.s: upa̱prāgā̍cchasa̍naṃ vā̱jyarvā̍ deva̱drīcā̱ mana̍sā dīdhyā̍naḥ a̱jaḥ puro nī̍yate̱ nābhi̍rasyā̱nu̍ pa̱ścātka̱vayo̍ yanti re̱bhāḥ
279.d: उप̱प्रागा̍च्छस̍नं वा̱ज्यर्वा̍ देव̱द्रीचा̱ मन̍सा दीध्या̍नः अ̱जः पुरो नी̍यते̱ नाभि̍रस्या̱नु̍ प̱श्चात्क̱वयो̍ यन्ति रे̱भाः
279.m:
The swift steed has approached the place of slaughter, meditating with mind directed to the gods;
the he-goat is led before, his companion; behind him go the inspired poets, the singers.

279.s: upa̱ prāgā̍tpara̱maṃ yatsa̱dhastha̱marvā̱2 achā̍ pi̱tara̍ṃ mā̱tara̍ṃ ca a̱dyā de̱vāñjuṣṭa̍tamo̱ hi ga̱myā athā̱ śāste̍ dā̱śuṣe̱ vāryā̍ṇi
279.d: उप̱ प्रागा̍त्पर̱मं यत्स̱धस्थ̱मर्वा̱2 अछा̍ पि̱तर̍ं मा̱तर̍ं च अ̱द्या दे̱वाञ्जुष्ट̍तमो̱ हि ग̱म्या अथा̱ शास्ते̍ दा̱शुषे̱ वार्या̍णि
279.m:
The steed has approached the highest dwelling-place, toward his father and his mother;
may he go today to the gods most welcome, and then announce precious gifts to the giver.

280.s: (3) sami̍ddho a̱dya manu̍ṣo duro̱ṇe de̱vo de̱vānya̍jasi jātavedaḥ ā ca̱ vaha̍ mitramahaściki̱tvāntvaṃ dū̱taḥ ka̱vira̍si prace̍tāḥ
280.d: (3) समि̍द्धो अ̱द्य मनु̍षो दुरो̱णे दे̱वो दे̱वान्य̍जसि जातवेदः आ च̱ वह̍ मित्रमहश्चिकि̱त्वान्त्वं दू̱तः क̱विर̍सि प्रचे̍ताः
280.m:
Kindled today in the dwelling of man, divine one, you sacrifice to the gods, o Jātavedas;
and bring them, o Mitra-ruler, knowing [the way]; you are the messenger, the wise poet, the perceptive one.

280.s: tanū̍napātpa̱tha ṛ̱tasya̱ yānā̱nmadhvā̍ sama̱ñjantsva̍dayā sujihva manmā̍ni dhī̱bhiru̱ta ya̱jñamṛ̍ndhande̱vatrā ca̍ kṛṇuhyadhva̱raṃ na̍ḥ
280.d: तनू̍नपात्प̱थ ऋ̱तस्य̱ याना̱न्मध्वा̍ सम̱ञ्जन्त्स्व̍दया सुजिह्व मन्मा̍नि धी̱भिरु̱त य̱ज्ञमृ̍न्धन्दे̱वत्रा च̍ कृणुह्यध्व̱रं न̍ः
280.m:
O Tanūnapāt, sweetening the paths that lead to truth with honey, make them pleasant, you of good tongue;
promoting sacred formulations through insights and the sacrifice, place our rite among the gods.

280.s: narā̱śaṃsa̍sya mahi̱māna̍meṣā̱mupa̍ stoṣāma yaja̱tasya̍ ya̱jñaiḥ ye su̱krata̍va̱ḥ śuca̍yo dhi̱yaṃghāḥ svada̍nti de̱vā u̱bhayā̍ni ha̱vyā
280.d: नरा̱शंस̍स्य महि̱मान̍मेषा̱मुप̍ स्तोषाम यज̱तस्य̍ य̱ज्ञैः ये सु̱क्रत̍व̱ः शुच̍यो धि̱यंघाः स्वद̍न्ति दे̱वा उ̱भया̍नि ह̱व्या
280.m:
With sacrifices let us praise the greatness of Narāśaṃsa, the worshipful among these,
who, full of purpose, pure, inspiring insights, the gods sweeten both oblations.

280.s: ā̱juhvā̍na̱ īḍyo̱ vandya̍ścā yā̍hyagne̱ vasu̍bhiḥ sa̱joṣā̍ḥ tvaṃ de̱vānā̍masi ya̱hva hotā̱ sa e̍nān yakṣīṣi̱to yajī̍yān
280.d: आ̱जुह्वा̍न̱ ईड्यो̱ वन्द्य̍श्चा या̍ह्यग्ने̱ वसु̍भिः स̱जोषा̍ः त्वं दे̱वाना̍मसि य̱ह्व होता̱ स ए̍नान् यक्षीषि̱तो यजी̍यान्
280.m:
Being invoked, to be praised and worshipped, come, o Agni, in harmony with the Vasus;
you are the youthful hotṛ priest of the gods; sacrifice to them, impelled, as an expert sacrificer.

280.s: prā̱cīna̍ṃ ba̱rhiḥ pra̱diśā̍ pṛthi̱vyā vasto̍rasyā vṛ̍jyate̱ agre̱ ahnā̍m vyu̍ prathate vita̱raṃ varī̍yo de̱vebhyo̱ adi̍taye syo̱nam
280.d: प्रा̱चीन̍ं ब̱र्हिः प्र̱दिशा̍ पृथि̱व्या वस्तो̍रस्या वृ̍ज्यते̱ अग्रे̱ अह्ना̍म् व्यु̍ प्रथते वित̱रं वरी̍यो दे̱वेभ्यो̱ अदि̍तये स्यो̱नम्
280.m:
Facing east, according to the earth's direction, the sacred grass is strewn at the dawn of days;
it spreads out further and wider, a soft seat for the gods, for Aditi.

280.s: vyaca̍svatīrurvi̱yā vi śra̍yantā̱ṃ pati̍bhyo̱ na jana̍ya̱ḥ śumbha̍mānāḥ de̱vīrdvāro̍ bṛha̱tīrvi̱śvaminvā̍ de̱vebhyo̍ bhavata suprāya̱ṇāḥ
280.d: व्यच̍स्वतीरुर्वि̱या वि श्र̍यन्ता̱ं पति̍भ्यो̱ न जन̍य̱ः शुम्भ̍मानाः दे̱वीर्द्वारो̍ बृह̱तीर्वि̱श्वमिन्वा̍ दे̱वेभ्यो̍ भवत सुप्राय̱णाः
280.m:
Spacious, let them open wide, adorning themselves like wives for husbands;
divine doors, lofty, all-enveloping, become easy of entry for the gods.

280.s: ā su̱ṣvaya̍ntī yaja̱te upā̍ke u̱ṣāsā̱naktā̍ sadatā̱ṃ ni yo̱nau di̱vye yoṣā̍ṇe bṛha̱tī su̍ru̱kme adhi̱ śriya̍m̐ śu̱krapiśa̱ṃ dadhā̍ne
280.d: आ सु̱ष्वय̍न्ती यज̱ते उपा̍के उ̱षासा̱नक्ता̍ सदता̱ं नि यो̱नौ दि̱व्ये योषा̍णे बृह̱ती सु̍रु̱क्मे अधि̱ श्रिय̍म्̐ शु̱क्रपिश̱ं दधा̍ने
280.m:
Yielding plentifully, worshipful, near at hand, let Dawn and Night sit down on the womb [of the altar];
two divine women, lofty, adorned with gold, putting on bright beauty.

280.s: daivyā̱ hotā̍rā pratha̱mā su̱vācā̱ mimā̍nā ya̱jñaṃ manu̍ṣo yaja̍dhyai pra̱coda̱yantā̍ vi̱dathai̍ṣu kā̱rū prā̱cīna̱ṃ jyoti̍ḥ pra̱diśa̍ṃ di̱śantā̍
280.d: दैव्या̱ होता̍रा प्रथ̱मा सु̱वाचा̱ मिमा̍ना य̱ज्ञं मनु̍षो यज̍ध्यै प्र̱चोद̱यन्ता̍ वि̱दथै̍षु का̱रू प्रा̱चीन̱ं ज्योति̍ः प्र̱दिश̍ं दि̱शन्ता̍
280.m:
The two divine hotṛ priests, primeval, sweet of speech, measuring the sacrifice for man to sacrifice,
urging on the poets in the gatherings, pointing the eastern light along its path.

280.s: ā no̍ ya̱jñaṃ bhāra̍tī̱ tūya̍me̱tviḷā̍ manu̱ṣvadi̱ha cetaya̍ntī ti̱sro de̱vīrba̱rhiredam̐ syo̱nam̐ sara̍svatī̱ svapa̍saḥ sadantu
280.d: आ नो̍ य̱ज्ञं भार̍ती̱ तूय̍मे̱त्विऌआ̍ मनु̱ष्वदि̱ह चेतय̍न्ती ति̱स्रो दे̱वीर्ब̱र्हिरेदम्̐ स्यो̱नम्̐ सर̍स्वती̱ स्वप̍सः सदन्तु
280.m:
Let Bhāratī come swiftly to our sacrifice, and Iḷā making herself known here like a human;
may the three goddesses sit on this soft sacred grass—Sarasvatī and the skillful ones.

280.s: ya i̱me dyāvā̍pṛthi̱vī jani̍trī rū̱pairapi̍ṃm̐śa̱dbhuva̍nāni̱ viśvā̍ tama̱dya ho̍tariṣi̱to yajī̍yānde̱vaṃ tvaṣṭā̍rami̱ha ya̍kṣi vi̱dvāna
280.d: य इ̱मे द्यावा̍पृथि̱वी जनि̍त्री रू̱पैरपि̍ंम्̐श̱द्भुव̍नानि̱ विश्वा̍ तम̱द्य हो̍तरिषि̱तो यजी̍यान्दे̱वं त्वष्टा̍रमि̱ह य̍क्षि वि̱द्वान
280.m:
He who fashioned these two, heaven and earth, the parents, with forms, and all beings—
to him today, hotṛ priest, impelled, an expert sacrificer, sacrifice to god Tvaṣṭṛ here, knowing [the way].

280.s: upāva̍sṛja̱ tmanyā̍ sa̱mañjande̱vānā̱ṃ pātha̍ ṛ̱tuthā ha̱vīm̐ṣi̍ vana̱spati̍ḥ śami̱tā de̱vo a̱gniḥ svada̍ntu ha̱vyaṃ madhu̍nā ghṛ̱tena̍
280.d: उपाव̍सृज̱ त्मन्या̍ स̱मञ्जन्दे̱वाना̱ं पाथ̍ ऋ̱तुथा ह̱वीम्̐षि̍ वन̱स्पति̍ः शमि̱ता दे̱वो अ̱ग्निः स्वद̍न्तु ह̱व्यं मधु̍ना घृ̱तेन̍
280.m:
Release of your own accord, anointing [them], the oblations in season to the dwelling of the gods;
may the Lord of the Forest, the slaughterer, the divine Agni sweeten the oblation with honey and ghee.

280.s: sa̱dyo jā̱to vya̍mimīta ya̱jñama̱gnirde̱vānā̍mabhavatpuro̱gāḥ a̱sya hotu̍ḥ pra̱diśyṛ̱tasya̍ vā̱ci svāhā̍kṛtam̐ ha̱vira̍dantu de̱vāḥ
280.d: स̱द्यो जा̱तो व्य̍मिमीत य̱ज्ञम̱ग्निर्दे̱वाना̍मभवत्पुरो̱गाः अ̱स्य होतु̍ः प्र̱दिश्यृ̱तस्य̍ वा̱चि स्वाहा̍कृतम्̐ ह̱विर̍दन्तु दे̱वाः
280.m:
As soon as born, Agni measured the sacrifice; he became the forerunner of the gods;
at the direction of this hotṛ priest, in the voice of truth, let the gods eat the oblation consecrated with svāhā.

281.s:
(4) a̱gnaye̍ gāya̱trāya̍ tri̱vṛte̍ rāthaṃta̱rāyāṣṭāka̍pāla̱ indrā̍ya traiṣṭu̍bhāya pañcada̱śāya̍ bārhatā̱yaikā̍daśakapālo vi̱śvebhyo̍ de̱vebhyo̍ jāga̍tebhyaḥ saptada̱śebhyo̍ vairū̱pebhyo̱ dvāda̍śakapālo mi̱trāvaru̍ṇābhyāmānuṣṭu̱bhābhyāmekavim̐śābhyā̍ṃ vairājā̱bhyām | paya̱syā bṛha̱spata̍ye pāṅktā̍ya triṇa̱vāya̍ śākva̱rāya̍ ca̱ruḥ sa̍vi̱tra auṣṇi̍hāya trayastrim̐śā̱ya raiva̱tāya̱ dvāda̍śakapālaḥ prājāpa̱tyaśca̱ruradi̍tyai vi̱ṣṇupa̍tnyai ca̱rura̱gnaye̍ vaiśvāna̱rāya̱ dvāda̍śakapālo'nu̍matyā aṣṭāka̍pālaḥ
(5) ā̱gne̱yaḥ kṛ̱ṣṇagrī̍vaḥ sārasva̱tī me̱ṣī ba̱bhruḥ sau̱myaḥ pau̱ṣṇaḥ śyā̱maḥ śi̍tipṛ̱ṣṭho bārha̍spa̱tyaḥ śi̱lpo vai̍śvade̱vaḥ | aindro̍'ru̱ṇo māru̍taḥ ka̱lmāṣa̍ aindrā̱gnaḥ saṃm̐hi̍to'dhorā̱maḥ sā̍vi̱tro vā̍ru̱ṇaḥ kṛ̱ṣṇa eka̍śitipa̱ātpetva̍ḥ
281.d:
(4) अ̱ग्नये̍ गाय̱त्राय̍ त्रि̱वृते̍ राथंत̱रायाष्टाक̍पाल̱ इन्द्रा̍य त्रैष्टु̍भाय पञ्चद̱शाय̍ बार्हता̱यैका̍दशकपालो वि̱श्वेभ्यो̍ दे̱वेभ्यो̍ जाग̍तेभ्यः सप्तद̱शेभ्यो̍ वैरू̱पेभ्यो̱ द्वाद̍शकपालो मि̱त्रावरु̍णाभ्यामानुष्टु̱भाभ्यामेकविम्̐शाभ्या̍ं वैराजा̱भ्याम् । पय̱स्या बृह̱स्पत̍ये पाङ्क्ता̍य त्रिण̱वाय̍ शाक्व̱राय̍ च̱रुः स̍वि̱त्र औष्णि̍हाय त्रयस्त्रिम्̐शा̱य रैव̱ताय̱ द्वाद̍शकपालः प्राजाप̱त्यश्च̱रुरदि̍त्यै वि̱ष्णुप̍त्न्यै च̱रुर̱ग्नये̍ वैश्वान̱राय̱ द्वाद̍शकपालोऽनु̍मत्या अष्टाक̍पालः
(5) आ̱ग्ने̱यः कृ̱ष्णग्री̍वः सारस्व̱ती मे̱षी ब̱भ्रुः सौ̱म्यः पौ̱ष्णः श्या̱मः शि̍तिपृ̱ष्ठो बार्ह̍स्प̱त्यः शि̱ल्पो वै̍श्वदे̱वः । ऐन्द्रो̍ऽरु̱णो मारु̍तः क̱ल्माष̍ ऐन्द्रा̱ग्नः संम्̐हि̍तोऽधोरा̱मः सा̍वि̱त्रो वा̍रु̱णः कृ̱ष्ण एक̍शितिप̱आत्पेत्व̍ः
281.m:
For Agni, associated with the gāyatrī, the threefold, the rathantara, an eight-pot-sherd cake; for Indra, associated with the triṣṭubh, the fifteenfold, the bṛhant, an eleven-pot-sherd cake; for the All-Gods, associated with the jagatī, the seventeenfold, the vairūpa, a twelve-pot-sherd cake; for Mitra and Varuṇa, associated with the anuṣṭubh, the twenty-onefold, the vairāja, a milk mess; for Bṛhaspati, associated with the paṅkti, the twenty-sevenfold, the śākvara, boiled rice; for Savitṛ, associated with the uṣṇih, the thirty-threefold, the raivata, a twelve-pot-sherd cake; for Prajāpati, boiled rice; for Aditi, wife of Viṣṇu, boiled rice; for Agni Vaiśvānara, a twelve-pot-sherd cake; for Anumati, an eight-pot-sherd cake.

Belonging to Agni is the black-necked; belonging to Sarasvatī, a ewe; brown, belonging to Soma; dark, belonging to Pūṣan; white-backed, belonging to Bṛhaspati; speckled, belonging to the All-Gods; red, belonging to Indra; piebald, belonging to the Maruts; belonging to Indrāgni, the joint one; dark-bellied, belonging to Savitṛ; black, one white-footed, belonging to Varuṇa, a ram.

281.s: (6) a̱gnaye'nī̍kavate̱ rohi̍tāñjirana̱ḍvāna̱dhorā̍mau sāvi̱trau pau̱ṣṇau ra̍jatanā̍bhī vaiśvade̱vau pi̱śaṅgau̍ tū̱parau mā̱ru̱taḥ ka̱lmāṣa̍ āgne̱yaḥ kṛ̱ṣṇo'jaḥ sā̍rasva̱tī me̱ṣī vā̍ru̱ṇaḥ petva̍ḥ
281.d: (6) अ̱ग्नयेऽनी̍कवते̱ रोहि̍ताञ्जिरन̱ड्वान̱धोरा̍मौ सावि̱त्रौ पौ̱ष्णौ र̍जतना̍भी वैश्वदे̱वौ पि̱शङ्गौ̍ तू̱परौ मा̱रु̱तः क̱ल्माष̍ आग्ने̱यः कृ̱ष्णोऽजः सा̍रस्व̱ती मे̱षी वा̍रु̱णः पेत्व̍ः
281.m:
For Agni with the vanguard, a red-striped draft-ox; two dark-bellied ones for Savitṛ; two with silver navels for Pūṣan; two yellowish hornless ones for the All-Gods;
a piebald one for the Maruts; a black he-goat for Agni; a ewe for Sarasvatī; a ram for Varuṇa.

282.s:
agnaye gāyatrāyaikā
āgneyaḥ kṛṣṇagrīva ekā
agnaye'nīkavata ityekā
282.d:
अग्नये गायत्रायैका
आग्नेयः कृष्णग्रीव एका
अग्नयेऽनीकवत इत्येका

283.s: a̱syājarā̍so damā̱mari̍trāṃ a̱rcaddhū̍māso a̱gnaya̍ḥ pāva̱kāḥ śvi̱tīcya̍ḥ śvā̱trāso̍ bhura̱ṇyavo̍ vana̱rṣado̍ vā̱yavo̱ na somā̍ḥ
283.d: अ̱स्याजरा̍सो दमा̱मरि̍त्रां अ̱र्चद्धू̍मासो अ̱ग्नय̍ः पाव̱काः श्वि̱तीच्य̍ः श्वा̱त्रासो̍ भुर̱ण्यवो̍ वन̱र्षदो̍ वा̱यवो̱ न सोमा̍ः
283.m: Ageless in the home, untiring, with blazing smoke, the purifying fires, / bright-shining, invigorating, quivering, dwelling in the woods, are like the Soma [drafts] of Vāyu.

283.s: ha̱ra̍yo dhūmake̍tavo vāta̍jūtā̱ upa̱ dyavi̍ | yata̍nte vṛ̱thaga̱gnaya̍ḥ
283.d: ह̱र̍यो धूमके̍तवो वात̍जूता̱ उप̱ द्यवि̍ । यत̍न्ते वृ̱थग̱ग्नय̍ः
283.m: Tawny, smoke-bannered, wind-impelled, up toward heaven / the fires strive, separately.

283.s: yajā̍ no mi̱trāvaru̍ṇā̱ yajā̍ de̱vām̐2 ṛ̱taṃ bṛ̱hat | agne̱ yakṣi̱ svaṃ dama̍m
283.d: यजा̍ नो मि̱त्रावरु̍णा̱ यजा̍ दे̱वाम्̐2 ऋ̱तं बृ̱हत् । अग्ने̱ यक्षि̱ स्वं दम̍म्
283.m: Sacrifice for us to Mitra and Varuṇa; sacrifice to the gods, to the great truth. / O Agni, sacrifice in your own home.

283.s: yu̱kṣvā hi de̍vahūta̍mām̐2 aśvā̍m̐2 agne ra̱thīri̍va | ni hotā̍ pū̱rvyaḥ sa̍daḥ
283.d: यु̱क्ष्वा हि दे̍वहूत̍माम्̐2 अश्वा̍म्̐2 अग्ने र̱थीरि̍व । नि होता̍ पू̱र्व्यः स̍दः
283.m: Yoke, like a charioteer, the horses that most summon the gods, O Agni; / sit down as the ancient Hotṛ.

283.s: dve virū̍pe carata̱ḥ svarthe̍ a̱nyānyā̍ va̱tsamupa̍ dhāpayete hari̍ra̱nyasyā̱ṃ bhava̍ti sva̱dhāvā̍ñchu̱kro a̱nyasyā̍ṃ dadṛśe suvarcā̍ḥ
283.d: द्वे विरू̍पे चरत̱ः स्वर्थे̍ अ̱न्यान्या̍ व̱त्समुप̍ धापयेते हरि̍र̱न्यस्या̱ं भव̍ति स्व̱धावा̍ञ्छु̱क्रो अ̱न्यस्या̍ं ददृशे सुवर्चा̍ः
283.m: Two of different forms wander with a single goal; alternately they suckle the calf. / In the one he becomes tawny, possessed of svadhā; in the other the bright one is seen, of splendid radiance.

283.s: a̱yami̱ha pra̍tha̱mo dhā̍yi dhā̱tṛbhi̱rhotā̱ yaji̍ṣṭho adhva̱reṣvīḍya̍ḥ yamapna̍vāno̱ bhṛga̍vo virurucurvane̍ṣu ci̱traṃ vi̱bhva̍ṃ vi̱śevi̍śe
283.d: अ̱यमि̱ह प्र̍थ̱मो धा̍यि धा̱तृभि̱र्होता̱ यजि̍ष्ठो अध्व̱रेष्वीड्य̍ः यमप्न̍वानो̱ भृग̍वो विरुरुचुर्वने̍षु चि̱त्रं वि̱भ्व̍ं वि̱शेवि̍शे
283.m: He was placed here as the first Hotṛ by the creators, the best sacrificer, worthy of praise at the sacrifices, / whom Apnavāna and the Bhṛgus kindled bright in the woods, far-reaching for every settlement.

283.s: trīṇi̍ śa̱tā trī sa̱hasrā̍ṇya̱gniṃ tri̱m̐śacca̍ de̱vā nava̍ cāsaparyan aukṣa̍nghṛ̱tairastṛ̍ṇan ba̱rhira̍smā̱ ādiddhotā̍ra̱ṃ nya̍sādayanta
283.d: त्रीणि̍ श̱ता त्री स̱हस्रा̍ण्य̱ग्निं त्रि̱म्̐शच्च̍ दे̱वा नव̍ चासपर्यन् औक्ष̍न्घृ̱तैरस्तृ̍णन् ब̱र्हिर̍स्मा̱ आदिद्धोता̍र̱ं न्य̍सादयन्त
283.m: Three thousand, three hundred, and thirty and nine gods attended upon Agni. / They sprinkled him with ghee; they strewed the sacred grass for him; and then they seated him as Hotṛ.

283.s: mū̱rdhāna̍ṃ di̱vo a̍ra̱tiṃ pṛ̍thi̱vyā vai̍śvāna̱ramṛ̱ta ā jā̱tama̱gnim ka̱vim̐ sa̱mrāja̱mati̍thiṃ janā̍nāmā̱sannā pātrā̍ṃ janayanta de̱vāḥ
283.d: मू̱र्धान̍ं दि̱वो अ̍र̱तिं पृ̍थि̱व्या वै̍श्वान̱रमृ̱त आ जा̱तम̱ग्निम् क̱विम्̐ स̱म्राज̱मति̍थिं जना̍नामा̱सन्ना पात्रा̍ं जनयन्त दे̱वाः
283.m: Head of heaven, navel of the earth, Vaiśvānara, Agni born in cosmic order, / the sage, the sovereign ruler, the guest of men: the gods generated him as a vessel in their mouth.

283.s: a̱gnirvṛ̱trāṇi̍ jaṅghanad draviṇa̱syurvipa̱nyayā̍ | sami̍ddhaḥ śu̱kra āhu̍taḥ
283.d: अ̱ग्निर्वृ̱त्राणि̍ जङ्घनद् द्रविण̱स्युर्विप̱न्यया̍ । समि̍द्धः शु̱क्र आहु̍तः
283.m: May Agni strike down the obstacles, desiring wealth through sacred song, / kindled, bright, greeted with oblations.

283.s: viśve̍bhiḥ so̱myaṃ madhvagna̱ indre̍ṇa vā̱yunā̍ | pibā̍ mi̱trasya̱ dhāma̍bhiḥ
283.d: विश्वे̍भिः सो̱म्यं मध्वग्न̱ इन्द्रे̍ण वा̱युना̍ । पिबा̍ मि̱त्रस्य̱ धाम̍भिः
283.m: With all [the gods], with Indra, and with Vāyu, O Agni, / drink the sweet soma draft according to the ordinances of Mitra.

283.s: ā yadi̱ṣe nṛ̱pati̱ṃ teja̱ āna̱ṭ śuci̱reto̱ niṣi̍ktaṃ dyaura̱bhīke̍ a̱gniḥ śardha̍manava̱dyaṃ yuvā̍nam̐ svā̱dhya̍ṃ janayatsū̱daya̍cca
283.d: आ यदि̱षे नृ̱पति̱ं तेज̱ आन̱ट् शुचि̱रेतो̱ निषि̍क्तं द्यौर̱भीके̍ अ̱ग्निः शर्ध̍मनव̱द्यं युवा̍नम्̐ स्वा̱ध्य̍ं जनयत्सू̱दय̍च्च
283.m: When the fiery glow reached the lord of men for refreshment, heaven poured down its bright seed nearby; / Agni produced and sped onward the blameless host, youthful and wise.

283.s: agne̱ śardha̍ maha̱te saubha̍gāya̱ tava̍ dyu̱mnānyu̍tta̱māni̍ santu saṃjā̍spatyam̐ su̱yama̱mā kṛ̍ṇuṣva śa̱trūya̱tāma̱bhi ti̍ṣṭhā̱ mahā̍ṃm̐si
283.d: अग्ने̱ शर्ध̍ मह̱ते सौभ̍गाय̱ तव̍ द्यु̱म्नान्यु̍त्त̱मानि̍ सन्तु संजा̍स्पत्यम्̐ सु̱यम̱मा कृ̍णुष्व श̱त्रूय̱ताम̱भि ति̍ष्ठा̱ महा̍ंम्̐सि
283.m: O Agni, show your power for great good fortune! May your splendors be supreme! / Make our wedded life well-ordered; trample down the powers of those who act as enemies.

283.s: tvām̐ hi ma̱ndrata̍mamarkaśo̱kairva̍vṛ̱mahe̱ mahi̍ naḥ śroṣyagne indra̱ṃ na tvā̱ śava̍sā de̱vatā̍ vā̱yuṃ pṛ̍ṇanti̱ rādha̍sā nṛtamāḥ
283.d: त्वाम्̐ हि म̱न्द्रत̍ममर्कशो̱कैर्व̍वृ̱महे̱ महि̍ नः श्रोष्यग्ने इन्द्र̱ं न त्वा̱ शव̍सा दे̱वता̍ वा̱युं पृ̍णन्ति̱ राध̍सा नृतमाः
283.m: We choose you, most delightful with your glowing chants; listen to our great [call], O Agni! / As with Indra in power, as with Vāyu the god, the most manly men satisfy [you] with wealth.

283.s: tve agne̱ svāhu̍ta pri̱yāsa̍ḥ santu sū̱raya̍ḥ ya̱ntāro̱ ye ma̱ghavā̍no janā̍nāmū̱rvāndaya̍nta̱ gonā̍m
283.d: त्वे अग्ने̱ स्वाहु̍त प्रि̱यास̍ः सन्तु सू̱रय̍ः य̱न्तारो̱ ये म̱घवा̍नो जना̍नामू̱र्वान्दय̍न्त̱ गोना̍म्
283.m: In you, O Agni, greeted with svāhā, may the patrons be dear, / the generous lords of men who control and allot the stalls of cattle.

283.s: śru̱dhi śru̍tkarṇa̱ vahni̍bhirde̱vairgne̱ sayā̍vabhiḥ āsī̍dantu ba̱rhiṣi̍ mi̱tro arya̱mā prā̍taryā̱vāṇo̍ adhva̱ram
283.d: श्रु̱धि श्रु̍त्कर्ण̱ वह्नि̍भिर्दे̱वैर्ग्ने̱ सया̍वभिः आसी̍दन्तु ब̱र्हिषि̍ मि̱त्रो अर्य̱मा प्रा̍तर्या̱वाणो̍ अध्व̱रम्
283.m: Listen, O hearer, together with the conveying gods, your companions, O Agni! / Let Mitra and Aryaman sit on the sacred grass, traveling early in the morning to the rite.

283.s: viśve̍ṣāmadi̍tirya̱jñiyā̍nā̱ṃ viśve̍ṣāmati̍thi̱rmānu̍ṣāṇām a̱gnirde̱vānā̱mava̍ āvṛṇā̱naḥ su̍mṛḷī̱ko bha̍vatu jā̱tave̍dāḥ
283.d: विश्वे̍षामदि̍तिर्य̱ज्ञिया̍ना̱ं विश्वे̍षामति̍थि̱र्मानु̍षाणाम् अ̱ग्निर्दे̱वाना̱मव̍ आवृणा̱नः सु̍मृऌई̱को भ̍वतु जा̱तवे̍दाः
283.m: The Aditi of all the worshipful gods, the guest of all men, / Agni, winning the favor of the gods, may Jātavedas be most gracious.

283.s: ma̱ho a̱gneḥ sa̍midhā̱nasya̱ śarma̍ṇyanā̍gā mi̱tre varu̍ṇe sva̱staye̍ śreṣṭhe̍ syāma savi̱tuḥ savī̍mani̱ tadde̱vānā̱mavo̍ a̱dyā vṛ̍ṇīmahe
283.d: म̱हो अ̱ग्नेः स̍मिधा̱नस्य̱ शर्म̍ण्यना̍गा मि̱त्रे वरु̍णे स्व̱स्तये̍ श्रेष्ठे̍ स्याम सवि̱तुः सवी̍मनि̱ तद्दे̱वाना̱मवो̍ अ̱द्या वृ̍णीमहे
283.m: In the great shelter of kindled Agni, sinless before Mitra and Varuṇa, may we be safe; / may we be in the finest impulsion of Savitṛ: this favor of the gods we choose today.

284.s: (1) ā̱pa̍ści̱tpi̱pyu sta̱ryo̍ na gāvo̱ nakṣa̍nnṛ̱taṃ ja̍ri̱tāra̍sta indra yā̱hi vā̱yurna ni̱yuto̍ no̱ acchā̱ tvam̐ hi dhī̱bhirdaya̍se̱ vi vājā̍n
284.d: (1) आ̱प̍श्चि̱त्पि̱प्यु स्त̱र्यो̍ न गावो̱ नक्ष̍न्नृ̱तं ज̍रि̱तार̍स्त इन्द्र या̱हि वा̱युर्न नि̱युतो̍ नो̱ अच्छा̱ त्वम्̐ हि धी̱भिर्दय̍से̱ वि वाजा̍न्
284.m: Even the waters swell, like sterile cows [made fertile]; your singers attain truth, O Indra. / Come toward our teams of steeds like Vāyu; for through your insights you distribute vital vigors.

284.s: gāva̱ upā̍vatāvataṃ ma̱hī ya̱jñasya̍ rapsu̱dā | u̱bhā karṇā̍ hira̱ṇyayā̍
284.d: गाव̱ उपा̍वतावतं म̱ही य̱ज्ञस्य̍ रप्सु̱दा । उ̱भा कर्णा̍ हिर̱ण्यया̍
284.m: The cows have aided the protection, the great gift of the sacrifice, / both golden ears.

284.s: yaddya sūra̱ udi̍te'nā̍gā mi̱tro a̍rya̱mā | su̱vāti̍ savi̱tā bhaga̍ḥ
284.d: यद्द्य सूर̱ उदि̍तेऽना̍गा मि̱त्रो अ̍र्य̱मा । सु̱वाति̍ सवि̱ता भग̍ः
284.m: When today, as the sun rises, sinless Mitra and Aryaman, / Savitṛ and Bhaga shall impel [us].

284.s: ā su̱te si̍ñcata̱ śriya̱m̐ roda̍syora̱bhiśriya̍m rasā̍ dadhīta vṛṣa̱bham | taṃ pra̱tnathā̱yaṃ ve̱naścau̍dayat
284.d: आ सु̱ते सि̍ञ्चत̱ श्रिय̱म्̐ रोद̍स्योर̱भिश्रिय̍म् रसा̍ दधीत वृष̱भम् । तं प्र̱त्नथा̱यं वे̱नश्चौ̍दयत्
284.m: Pour into the pressed [soma] the splendor, the radiance over both heaven and earth; / let the stream receive the bull; as of old, the longing Vena impelled him.

284.s: āti̍ṣṭhanta̱ṃ pari̱ viśve̍ abhūṣa̱ñchriyo̱ vasā̍naścarati sva̱roci̍ḥ ma̱hattadvṛṣṇo̱ asu̍rasya̱ nāmā vi̱śvarū̍po a̱mṛtā̍ni tasthau
284.d: आति̍ष्ठन्त̱ं परि̱ विश्वे̍ अभूष̱ञ्छ्रियो̱ वसा̍नश्चरति स्व̱रोचि̍ः म̱हत्तद्वृष्णो̱ असु̍रस्य̱ नामा वि̱श्वरू̍पो अ̱मृता̍नि तस्थौ
284.m: All [gods] attended him as he mounted; clothed in splendors he moves, self-luminous. / Great is that name of the bull, the Asura; multiform, he took his stand over the immortals.

284.s: pra vo̍ ma̱he manda̍mānā̱yāndha̍so'rcā̍ vi̱śvāna̍rāya vi̱śvābhu̍ve indra̍sya̱ yasya̱ suma̍kham̐ saho̍ ma̱hi śravo̍ nṛ̱mṇaṃ ca̱ roda̍sī sa̱parya̍taḥ
284.d: प्र वो̍ म̱हे मन्द̍माना̱यान्ध̍सोऽर्चा̍ वि̱श्वान̍राय वि̱श्वाभु̍वे इन्द्र̍स्य̱ यस्य̱ सुम̍खम्̐ सहो̍ म̱हि श्रवो̍ नृ̱म्णं च̱ रोद̍सी स̱पर्य̍तः
284.m: Sing forth to the great one who delights in the drink, belonging to all men, existing in all; / of Indra, whose great, noble might, fame, and manly power heaven and earth serve.

284.s: bṛ̱hadbhi̍di̱dhma e̍ṣā̱ṃ bhūri̍ śa̱staṃ pṛ̱thuḥ sva̍ruḥ | yeṣā̱mindro̱ yuvā̱ sakhā̍
284.d: बृ̱हद्भि̍दि̱ध्म ए̍षा̱ं भूरि̍ श̱स्तं पृ̱थुः स्व̍रुः । येषा̱मिन्द्रो̱ युवा̱ सखा̍
284.m: Lofty is their kindling stick, abundant their praise, broad their sacrificial post-chip, / they whose youthful friend is Indra.

284.s: indre̱hi matsyandha̍so̱ viśve̍bhiḥ soma̱parva̍bhiḥ | ma̱hām̐2 a̍bhi̱ṣṭiroja̍sā
284.d: इन्द्रे̱हि मत्स्यन्ध̍सो̱ विश्वे̍भिः सोम̱पर्व̍भिः । म̱हाम्̐2 अ̍भि̱ष्टिरोज̍सा
284.m: Come here, Indra, intoxicate yourself on the plant-juice, through all the Soma-gatherings, / you great helper through your power.

284.s: indro̍ vṛ̱trama̍vṛṇocchardhanī̱tiḥ pra mā̱yinā̍maminā̱dvarpa̍ṇītiḥ aha̱nvya̍m̐samuśa̱dhagvane̍ṣvāvi̱rdhenā̍ akṛṇodrāmyāṇā̍m
284.d: इन्द्रो̍ वृ̱त्रम̍वृणोच्छर्धनी̱तिः प्र मा̱यिना̍ममिना̱द्वर्प̍णीतिः अह̱न्व्य̍म्̐समुश̱धग्वने̍ष्वावि̱र्धेना̍ अकृणोद्राम्याणा̍म्
284.m: Indra enveloped Vṛtra, of bold conduct; in his conduct of forms he broke down the deceitful ones; / he struck down Vyaṃsa as fire burns woods; he made visible the songs of the night.

284.s: kuta̱stvami̍ndra̱ māhi̍naḥ sanneko̍ yāsi satpate̱ kiṃ ta̍ itthā saṃ pṛ̍cchase samarā̱ṇaḥ śu̍bhā̱nairvo̍cestanno̍ harivo̱ yatte̍ a̱sme ma̱hām̐2 indro̱ ya oja̍sā kṛ̱dā ca̱na stu̱rīra̍si kṛ̱dā ca̱na prayu̍cchasi
284.d: कुत̱स्त्वमि̍न्द्र̱ माहि̍नः सन्नेको̍ यासि सत्पते̱ किं त̍ इत्था सं पृ̍च्छसे समरा̱णः शु̍भा̱नैर्वो̍चेस्तन्नो̍ हरिवो̱ यत्ते̍ अ̱स्मे म̱हाम्̐2 इन्द्रो̱ य ओज̍सा कृ̱दा च̱न स्तु̱रीर̍सि कृ̱दा च̱न प्रयु̍च्छसि
284.m: Whence, O Indra, being mighty, do you go alone, O lord of the good? What is your intent? / You consult, coming together with the adorned ones. Tell us that, O lord of bay steeds, which you have for us! / Great is Indra, who through his power is never barren, never negligent.

284.s: ā tatte̍ indrā̱ya va̍ḥ pananta̱ābhi ya ū̱rvaṃ goma̍ntaṃ ti̱tṛtsa̍ān sa̱kṛtsvaṃ ye pu̍rupu̱trāṃ ma̱hīm̐ sa̱hasra̍dhārāṃ bṛ̱hatī̍ṃ du̱dukṣa̍n
284.d: आ तत्ते̍ इन्द्रा̱य व̍ः पनन्त̱आभि य ऊ̱र्वं गोम̍न्तं ति̱तृत्स̍आन् स̱कृत्स्वं ये पु̍रुपु̱त्रां म̱हीम्̐ स̱हस्र̍धारां बृ̱हती̍ं दु̱दुक्ष̍न्
284.m: They praise this [deed] of yours for Indra, who wished to shatter the pen rich in cattle, / they who at once wished to milk the great, thousand-streamed, lofty one of many children, belonging to him alone.

284.s: i̱māṃ te̱ dhiya̱ṃ pra bha̍re ma̱ho ma̱hīma̱sya sto̱tre dhiṣaṇā̱ yatta̍ āna̱je tamu̍tsa̱ve ca̍ prasa̱ve ca̍ sāsaha̱mindra̍ṃ de̱vāsa̱ḥ śava̍sāmadannanu̍
284.d: इ̱मां ते̱ धिय̱ं प्र भ̍रे म̱हो म̱हीम̱स्य स्तो̱त्रे धिषणा̱ यत्त̍ आन̱जे तमु̍त्स̱वे च̍ प्रस̱वे च̍ सासह̱मिन्द्र̍ं दे̱वास̱ः शव̍सामदन्ननु̍
284.m: I bring forward this great insight for you, the great one, which sacred receptacle has anointed for his praise; / Indra, victorious in contest and in birth, the gods have cheered along with power.

285.s: (2) vi̱bhrāḍ bṛ̱hatpi̍batu so̱myaṃ madhvāyurdadha̍dya̱jñapa̍tā̱ avi̍hṛtam vāta̍jūto̱ yo a̍bhi̱rakṣa̍ti̱ tmanā̍ pra̱jāḥ pu̍poṣa puru̱dhā vi rā̍jati
285.d: (2) वि̱भ्राड् बृ̱हत्पि̍बतु सो̱म्यं मध्वायुर्दध̍द्य̱ज्ञप̍ता̱ अवि̍हृतम् वात̍जूतो̱ यो अ̍भि̱रक्ष̍ति̱ त्मना̍ प्र̱जाः पु̍पोष पुरु̱धा वि रा̍जति
285.m: May Vibhrāj, the great one, drink the sweet soma draft, granting unswerving life to the lord of sacrifice; / wind-impelled, he who protects by himself, he has nourished creatures, he rules manifoldly.

285.s: udu̱ tyaṃ jā̱tave̍dasaṃ de̱vaṃ va̍hanti ke̱tava̍ḥ | dṛ̱śe viśvā̍ya̱ sūrya̍m
285.d: उदु̱ त्यं जा̱तवे̍दसं दे̱वं व̍हन्ति के̱तव̍ः । दृ̱शे विश्वा̍य̱ सूर्य̍म्
285.m: Upward his rays bear that god, Jātavedas, / the Sun, for all to see.

285.s: yenā̍ pāvaka̱ cakṣa̍sā bhura̱ṇyanta̱ṃ janā̍m̐2 anu̍ | tvaṃ va̍ruṇa̱ paśya̍si
285.d: येना̍ पावक̱ चक्ष̍सा भुर̱ण्यन्त̱ं जना̍म्̐2 अनु̍ । त्वं व̍रुण̱ पश्य̍सि
285.m: With that eye wherewith, O purifier Varuṇa, you look upon / the zealous one among men.

285.s: daivyā̍ adhva̱ryū ā ga̍ta̱m̐ rathe̍na̱ sūrya̍tvacā | madhvā̍ ya̱jñam̐ sama̍ñjāthe taṃ pra̱tnathā̱yaṃ ve̱naśco̍daya̱tpṛśni̍ de̱vānā̍m
285.d: दैव्या̍ अध्व̱र्यू आ ग̍त̱म्̐ रथे̍न̱ सूर्य̍त्वचा । मध्वा̍ य̱ज्ञम्̐ सम̍ञ्जाथे तं प्र̱त्नथा̱यं वे̱नश्चो̍दय̱त्पृश्नि̍ दे̱वाना̍म्
285.m: O divine Adhvaryus, come on your chariot with sun-like skin; anoint the sacrifice with sweetness! / As of old, this longing Vena impelled him, the bright [eye] of the gods.

285.s: ā na̱ iḷā̍bhirvi̱dathe̍ suśa̱sti viśvā̍naraḥ savi̱tā de̱va e̍tu api̱ yathā̍ yu̱vāno̱ matsa̍thā no̱ viśva̱ṃ jaga̍dabhi̱pitve manī̱ṣā
285.d: आ न̱ इऌआ̍भिर्वि̱दथे̍ सुश̱स्ति विश्वा̍नरः सवि̱ता दे̱व ए̍तु अपि̱ यथा̍ यु̱वानो̱ मत्स̍था नो̱ विश्व̱ं जग̍दभि̱पित्वे मनी̱षा
285.m: May god Savitṛ, belonging to all men, worthy of praise, come to us with refreshments at the assembly, / so that, youthful ones, you may delight in us; the whole moving world [turns] toward our thought at the arrival.

285.s: yadu̱dya kacca̍ vṛtrahannuda̱gā̍ a̱bhi sūrya̍ | sarva̱ṃ tadi̍ndra̱ te vaśe̍
285.d: यदु̱द्य कच्च̍ वृत्रहन्नुद̱गा̍ अ̱भि सूर्य̍ । सर्व̱ं तदि̍न्द्र̱ ते वशे̍
285.m: Whatever today, O slayer of Vṛtra, as the sun, you have ascended to, / all that, O Indra, is in your power.

285.s: ta̱raṇi̍rvi̱śvada̍rśato jyoti̱ṣkṛda̍si sūrya | viśva̱mā bhā̍si roca̱nam
285.d: त̱रणि̍र्वि̱श्वद̍र्शतो ज्योति̱ष्कृद̍सि सूर्य । विश्व̱मा भा̍सि रोच̱नम्
285.m: Swift, visible to all, maker of light are you, O Sun; / you illuminate all the bright realm.

285.s: tatsū̱rya̍sya de̱va̱tvaṃ tanma̍hi̱tvaṃ ma̱dhyā karto̱rvita̍ta̱m̐ saṃ ja̍bhāra ya̱dedayu̍kta ha̱rita̍ḥ sa̱dhasthā̱dādrātrī̱ vāsa̍stanute si̱masmai̍
285.d: तत्सू̱र्य̍स्य दे̱व̱त्वं तन्म̍हि̱त्वं म̱ध्या कर्तो̱र्वित̍त̱म्̐ सं ज̍भार य̱देदयु̍क्त ह̱रित̍ः स̱धस्था̱दाद्रात्री̱ वास̍स्तनुते सि̱मस्मै̍
285.m: That is the godhead of the Sun, that his greatness: in the midst of his work he has drawn back what was outspread; / when he has unyoked the bay mares from their station, then Night spreads her garment over everyone.

285.s: tanmi̱trasya̱ varu̍ṇasyābhi̱cakṣe̱ sūryo̍ rū̱paṃ kṛ̍ṇute̱ dyoru̱pasthe̍ a̱na̱ntamanyadruśa̍dasya̱ pāja̍ḥ kṛ̱ṣṇama̱nyaddha̱rita̱ḥ saṃ bha̍ranti
285.d: तन्मि̱त्रस्य̱ वरु̍णस्याभि̱चक्षे̱ सूर्यो̍ रू̱पं कृ̍णुते̱ द्योरु̱पस्थे̍ अ̱न̱न्तमन्यद्रुश̍दस्य̱ पाज̍ः कृ̱ष्णम̱न्यद्ध̱रित̱ः सं भ̍रन्ति
285.m: That form Sūrya creates in the lap of heaven, for Mitra and Varuṇa to look upon; / one of his bright hosts is infinite, the other, black, his bay horses gather together.

285.s: ba̱ṇma̱hām̐2 a̍si sūrya ba̱ḷādi̍tya ma̱hām̐2 a̍si ma̱haste̍ sa̱to ma̍hi̱mā pa̍nasyate̱'ddhā de̍va ma̱hām̐2 a̍si
285.d: ब̱ण्म̱हाम्̐2 अ̍सि सूर्य ब̱ऌआदि̍त्य म̱हाम्̐2 अ̍सि म̱हस्ते̍ स̱तो म̍हि̱मा प̍नस्यते̱ऽद्धा दे̍व म̱हाम्̐2 अ̍सि
285.m: Truly great are you, Sūrya; truly, Āditya, you are great. / The greatness of you who are mighty is praised; truly, god, you are great.

285.s: baṭ sū̍rya̱ śrava̍sā ma̱hām̐2 a̍si sa̱trā de̍va ma̱hām̐2 a̍si ma̱hnā de̱vānā̍masu̱rya̍ḥ pu̱rohi̍to vi̱bhu jyotī̱radā̍bhyam
285.d: बट् सू̍र्य̱ श्रव̍सा म̱हाम्̐2 अ̍सि स̱त्रा दे̍व म̱हाम्̐2 अ̍सि म̱ह्ना दे̱वाना̍मसु̱र्य̍ः पु̱रोहि̍तो वि̱भु ज्योती̱रदा̍भ्यम्
285.m: Truly, Sūrya, in fame you are great; truly, god, you are great. / By might, the Asura among the gods, the purohita, the far-reaching, undeceivable light.

285.s: śrāya̍nta iva̱ sūrya̱ṃ viśvedindra̍sya bhakṣata vasū̍ni jā̱te jana̍māna̱ oja̍sā prati̍ bhā̱gaṃ na dī̍dhima
285.d: श्राय̍न्त इव̱ सूर्य̱ं विश्वेदिन्द्र̍स्य भक्षत वसू̍नि जा̱ते जन̍मान̱ ओज̍सा प्रति̍ भा̱गं न दी̍धिम
285.m: Clinging like [men] to Sūrya, all of you share in Indra's [wealth]. / When goods are born or being born, we ponder our share through [his] power.

285.s: a̱dyā de̍vā udi̍tā sūrya̍sya niram̐ha̍saḥ pipṛ̱tā nira̍va̱dyāt tanno̍ mi̱tro varu̍ṇo māmahantā̱madi̍tiḥ sindhu̍ḥ pṛthi̱vī u̱ta dyauḥ
285.d: अ̱द्या दे̍वा उदि̍ता सूर्य̍स्य निरम्̐ह̍सः पिपृ̱ता निर̍व̱द्यात् तन्नो̍ मि̱त्रो वरु̍णो मामहन्ता̱मदि̍तिः सिन्धु̍ः पृथि̱वी उ̱त द्यौः
285.m: Today, gods, at the rising of Sūrya, deliver us from distress, from reproach! / May Mitra, Varuṇa, Aditi, Sindhu, earth, and heaven grant us this!

285.s: ā kṛ̱ṣṇena̱ raja̍sā̱ varta̍māno nive̱śaya̍nna̱mṛta̱ṃ martya̍ṃ ca hi̱ra̱ṇyaye̍na savi̱tā rathe̱nā de̱vo yā̍ti̱ bhuva̍nāni̱ paśya̍n
285.d: आ कृ̱ष्णेन̱ रज̍सा̱ वर्त̍मानो निवे̱शय̍न्न̱मृत̱ं मर्त्य̍ं च हि̱र̱ण्यये̍न सवि̱ता रथे̱ना दे̱वो या̍ति̱ भुव̍नानि̱ पश्य̍न्
285.m: Rolling through the dark realm, laying to rest the immortal and the mortal, / god Savitṛ approaches on his golden chariot, looking upon the creatures.

286.s: (3) pra vā̍vṛje supra̱yā ba̱rhire̍ṣāmā vi̱śpatī̍va bī̱riṭa̍ iyāte vi̱śāma̱ktoru̱ṣasa̍ḥ pūrva̱hūtau̍ vā̱yuḥ pū̱ṣā sva̱staye̍ ni̱yutvā̍n
286.d: (3) प्र वा̍वृजे सुप्र̱या ब̱र्हिरे̍षामा वि̱श्पती̍व बी̱रिट̍ इयाते वि̱शाम̱क्तोरु̱षस̍ः पूर्व̱हूतौ̍ वा̱युः पू̱षा स्व̱स्तये̍ नि̱युत्वा̍न्
286.m: The strew of these [gods] is laid out, of fine approach; like two lords of the clan, they go to the wide space, / at the early call of the day and dawn to the clans: Vāyu, Pūṣan, accompanied by his teams, for well-being.

286.s: indra̍vā̱yū bṛha̱spati̍ṃ mi̱trāgniṃ pū̱ṣaṇa̱ṃ bhaga̍m | ā̱di̱tyānmāru̍taṃ ga̱ṇam
286.d: इन्द्र̍वा̱यू बृह̱स्पति̍ं मि̱त्राग्निं पू̱षण̱ं भग̍म् । आ̱दि̱त्यान्मारु̍तं ग̱णम्
286.m: Indra-Vāyu, Bṛhaspati, Mitra-Agni, Pūṣan, Bhaga, / the Ādityas, the troop of the Maruts.

286.s: varu̍ṇaḥ prāvi̱tā bhu̍vanmi̱tro viśvā̍bhirū̱tibhi̍ḥ | kara̍tāṃ naḥ su̱rādha̍saḥ
286.d: वरु̍णः प्रावि̱ता भु̍वन्मि̱त्रो विश्वा̍भिरू̱तिभि̍ः । कर̍तां नः सु̱राध̍सः
286.m: May Varuṇa be our protector, Mitra with all his aids; / may both make us abundantly wealthy.

286.s: a̱rdhaṃ na indrai̱ṣāṃ viṣṇo̍ sajā̱tyā̍nām | i̱tā maru̍to aśvinā taṃ pra̱tnathā̱yaṃ ve̱naśco̍daya̱dye de̍vā̱s ā na̱ iḷā̍bhirvi̱śve̍bhiḥ so̱myaṃ madhvomā̍saścarṣaṇī̱dhṛta̍ḥ
286.d: अ̱र्धं न इन्द्रै̱षां विष्णो̍ सजा̱त्या̍नाम् । इ̱ता मरु̍तो अश्विना तं प्र̱त्नथा̱यं वे̱नश्चो̍दय̱द्ये दे̍वा̱स् आ न̱ इऌआ̍भिर्वि̱श्वे̍भिः सो̱म्यं मध्वोमा̍सश्चर्षणी̱धृत̍ः
286.m: Care for these our kin, Indra and Viṣṇu! Come, Maruts and Aśvins! / As of old, this Vena urged on... whichever gods [come] to us with refreshments, through all, the sweet soma-drink, the helpers who sustain the peoples.

286.s: a̱gna indra̱ varu̍ṇa mi̱tra de̍vāḥ śardha̍ḥ pra ya̍nta̱ māru̍tota vi̍ṣṇo u̱bhā nāsa̍tyā ru̱dro adha̱ gnāḥ pū̱ṣā bhaga̱ḥ sara̍svatī juṣanta
286.d: अ̱ग्न इन्द्र̱ वरु̍ण मि̱त्र दे̍वाः शर्ध̍ः प्र य̍न्त̱ मारु̍तोत वि̍ष्णो उ̱भा नास̍त्या रु̱द्रो अध̱ ग्नाः पू̱षा भग̱ः सर̍स्वती जुषन्त
286.m: Agni, Indra, Varuṇa, Mitra, gods, and host of the Maruts, reach forth, and Viṣṇu! / May both Nāsatyas, Rudra, and then the goddesses, Pūṣan, Bhaga, Sarasvatī be pleased!

286.s: indrāgnī mitrāvaruṇāditim̐ svaḥ pṛthivīṃ dyāṃ marutaḥ parvatām̐2 apaḥ huve viṣṇuṃ pūṣaṇaṃ brahmaṇaspatiṃ bhagaṃ nu śam̐saṃm̐ savitāramūtaye
286.d: इन्द्राग्नी मित्रावरुणादितिम्̐ स्वः पृथिवीं द्यां मरुतः पर्वताम्̐2 अपः हुवे विष्णुं पूषणं ब्रह्मणस्पतिं भगं नु शम्̐संम्̐ सवितारमूतये
286.m: Indrāgnī, Mitrāvaruṇā, Aditi, heaven, earth, sky, the Maruts, mountains, waters, / Viṣṇu, Pūṣan, Brahmaṇaspati, Bhaga, and the praiseworthy Savitṛ I call now for aid.

286.s: asme rudrā mehanā parvatāso vṛtrahatye bharahūtau sajoṣāḥ yaḥ śam̐sate stuvate dhāyi pajra indrajyeṣṭhā asmām̐2 avantu devāḥ
286.d: अस्मे रुद्रा मेहना पर्वतासो वृत्रहत्ये भरहूतौ सजोषाः यः शम्̐सते स्तुवते धायि पज्र इन्द्रज्येष्ठा अस्माम्̐2 अवन्तु देवाः
286.m: May the Rudras, bountiful mountains, in unison for us in the slaying of Vṛtra, at the call of the battle, / he who has established for the praiser, the singer, the solid [wealth]—may the gods, with Indra as their eldest, protect us.

286.s: arvāñco adyā bhavatā yajatrā ā vo hārdi bhayamāno vyayeyam trādhvaṃ no devā nijuro vṛkasya trādhvaṃ kartādavapado yajatrāḥ
286.d: अर्वाञ्चो अद्या भवता यजत्रा आ वो हार्दि भयमानो व्ययेयम् त्राध्वं नो देवा निजुरो वृकस्य त्राध्वं कर्तादवपदो यजत्राः
286.m: Turn toward us today, worthy of sacrifice! Fearing, I would enter into your heart. / Protect us, gods, from the snap of the wolf; protect us, worthy of sacrifice, from falling into the pit!

286.s: viśve adya maruto viśva ūtī viśve bhavantvagnayaḥ samiddhāḥ viśve no devā avasā gamantu viśvamastu draviṇaṃ vājo asme
286.d: विश्वे अद्य मरुतो विश्व ऊती विश्वे भवन्त्वग्नयः समिद्धाः विश्वे नो देवा अवसा गमन्तु विश्वमस्तु द्रविणं वाजो अस्मे
286.m: May all the Maruts be with us today, all with help; may all the fires be kindled! / May all the gods come to us with aid; may all wealth and vital vigor be ours!

286.s: viśve devāḥ śṛṇutemam̐ havaṃ me ye antarikṣe ya upa dyavi ṣṭha ye agnijihvā uta vā yajatrā āsadyāsminbarhiṣi mādayadhvam
286.d: विश्वे देवाः शृणुतेमम्̐ हवं मे ये अन्तरिक्षे य उप द्यवि ष्ठ ये अग्निजिह्वा उत वा यजत्रा आसद्यास्मिन्बर्हिषि मादयध्वम्
286.m: All-Gods, hear this call of mine, you who are in mid-air, you who are in heaven, / you whose tongue is Agni, or who are worthy of sacrifice: sit down upon this sacred strew and rejoice!

286.s: devebhyo hi prathamaṃ yajñiyebhyo'mṛtatvam̐ suvasi bhāgamuttamam ādiddāmānam̐ savitarvyūrṇuṣe'nūcīnā jīvitā mānuṣebhyaḥ
286.d: देवेभ्यो हि प्रथमं यज्ञियेभ्योऽमृतत्वम्̐ सुवसि भागमुत्तमम् आदिद्दामानम्̐ सवितर्व्यूर्णुषेऽनूचीना जीविता मानुषेभ्यः
286.m: For first to the gods worthy of sacrifice you impel immortality as the highest portion; / and then, Savitṛ, you reveal your gift, successive lives for mortal men.

287.s: (4) pra vāyumacchā bṛhatī manīṣā bṛhadrayiṃ viśvavāram̐ rathaprām dyutadyāmā niyutaḥ patyamānaḥ kaviḥ kavimiyakṣasi prayajyo
287.d: (4) प्र वायुमच्छा बृहती मनीषा बृहद्रयिं विश्ववारम्̐ रथप्राम् द्युतद्यामा नियुतः पत्यमानः कविः कविमियक्षसि प्रयज्यो
287.m: The lofty poetic vision goes forth toward Vāyu, of lofty wealth, all-desirable, filling the chariot, / whose course is bright, possessing his teams. As a poet, you worship the poet, O worthy of sacrifice!

287.s: indravāyū ime sutā upa prayobhirā gatam | indavo vāmuśanti hi
287.d: इन्द्रवायू इमे सुता उप प्रयोभिरा गतम् । इन्दवो वामुशन्ति हि
287.m: Indra-Vāyu, these [somas] are pressed; come to our feast-offerings! / For the drops desire you both.

287.s: mitram̐ huve pūtadakṣaṃ varuṇaṃ ca riśādasam | dhiyaṃ ghṛtācīm̐ sādhantā
287.d: मित्रम्̐ हुवे पूतदक्षं वरुणं च रिशादसम् । धियं घृताचीम्̐ साधन्ता
287.m: I call Mitra of purified skill and Varuṇa who destroys the foe, / accomplishing their insight gleaming with ghee.

287.s: dasrā yuvākavaḥ sutā nāsatyā vṛktabarhiṣaḥ | ā yātam̐ rudravartanī taṃ pratnathā yaṃ venaścodayat
287.d: दस्रा युवाकवः सुता नासत्या वृक्तबर्हिषः । आ यातम्̐ रुद्रवर्तनी तं प्रत्नथा यं वेनश्चोदयत्
287.m: Wondrous, youthful [gods], Nāsatyas, the somas are pressed with the strew trimmed; / come, you who follow Rudra's path! / As of old, this Vena urged on...

287.s: vidadyadī saramā rugṇamadrermahi pāthaḥ pūrvyam̐ sadhryakkaḥ agraṃ nayatsupadyakṣarāṇāmacchā ravaṃ prathamā jānatī gāt
287.d: विदद्यदी सरमा रुग्णमद्रेर्महि पाथः पूर्व्यम्̐ सध्र्यक्कः अग्रं नयत्सुपद्यक्षराणामच्छा रवं प्रथमा जानती गात्
287.m: When Saramā found the cleft of the rock, the great, ancient path she made straight. / Leading at the head of the swift-footed, imperishable [cows], knowing [the way], she was the first to go toward the sound.

287.s: nahi spaśamavidannanyamasmādvaiśvānarātpura etāramagneḥ emenamavṛdhannamṛtā amartyaṃ vaiśvānaraṃ kṣatrajityāya devāḥ
287.d: नहि स्पशमविदन्नन्यमस्माद्वैश्वानरात्पुर एतारमग्नेः एमेनमवृधन्नमृता अमर्त्यं वैश्वानरं क्षत्रजित्याय देवाः
287.m: They found no other spy than this Agni Vaiśvānara to go before them. / The immortal gods made this immortal Vaiśvānara increase for the winning of fields.

287.s: ugrā vighninā mṛdha indrāgnī havāmahe | tā no mṛḷāta īdṛśe
287.d: उग्रा विघ्निना मृध इन्द्राग्नी हवामहे । ता नो मृऌआत ईदृशे
287.m: Fierce, dispersing the battles, we invoke Indrāgnī; / may they be gracious to us in such a plight.

287.s: upāsmai gāyata naraḥ pavamānāyendave | abhi devām̐2 iyakṣate
287.d: उपास्मै गायत नरः पवमानायेन्दवे । अभि देवाम्̐2 इयक्षते
287.m: Sing to this self-purifying drop, heroes, / as he seeks to reach the gods!

287.s: ye tvāhihatye maghavannavardhanye śāmbare harivo ye ga iṣṭau ye tvāṃ nūnamanumadanti viprāḥ pibendra somam̐ sagaṇo marudbhiḥ
287.d: ये त्वाहिहत्ये मघवन्नवर्धन्ये शाम्बरे हरिवो ये ग इष्टौ ये त्वां नूनमनुमदन्ति विप्राः पिबेन्द्र सोमम्̐ सगणो मरुद्भिः
287.m: Who strengthened you, bounteous one, in the slaying of the serpent, who in that of Śambara, lord of bay steeds, who in the quest for cows, / who now acclaim you, the inspired seers: drink the soma, Indra, together with the troop of the Maruts!

287.s: janiṣṭhā ugraḥ sahase turāya mandra ojiṣṭho bahulābhimānaḥ avardhannindraṃ marutaścidatra mātā yadvīraṃ dadhanaddhaniṣṭhā
287.d: जनिष्ठा उग्रः सहसे तुराय मन्द्र ओजिष्ठो बहुलाभिमानः अवर्धन्निन्द्रं मरुतश्चिदत्र माता यद्वीरं दधनद्धनिष्ठा
287.m: Born fierce for swift mastery, delightful, most strong, of manifold intent; / the Maruts strengthened Indra here, when the mother, most wealthy, bore the hero.

287.s: ā tū na̍ indra vṛtrahanna̱smāka̍ma̱rdhamā ga̍hi | ma̱hānma̱hībhi̍rū̱tibhi̍ḥ
287.d: आ तू न̍ इन्द्र वृत्रहन्न̱स्माक̍म̱र्धमा ग̍हि । म̱हान्म̱हीभि̍रू̱तिभि̍ः
287.m: Come then, Indra, slayer of Vṛtra, to our side, / great, with great aids!

287.s: tvami̍ndra pra̱tūrti̍ṣva̱bhi viśvā̍ asi spṛdha̍ḥ aśa̍stihā ja̍nitā vi̱śvatū̍rasi̱ tvaṃ tūrya̍ taruṣya̱taḥ
287.d: त्वमि̍न्द्र प्र̱तूर्ति̍ष्व̱भि विश्वा̍ असि स्पृध̍ः अश̍स्तिहा ज̍निता वि̱श्वतू̍रसि̱ त्वं तूर्य̍ तरुष्य̱तः
287.m: You, Indra, in onward rushes, overcome all rivals. / Destroyer of insults, father, conquering all are you: overcome the assailant!

287.s: anu̍ te̱ śuṣma̍ṃ turaya̍ntamīyatuḥ kṣo̱ṇī śiśu̱ṃ na mā̱tarā̍ viśvā̍ste̱ spṛdha̍ḥ śnathayanta ma̱nyave̍ vṛ̱traṃ yadi̍ndra̱ tūrva̍si
287.d: अनु̍ ते̱ शुष्म̍ं तुरय̍न्तमीयतुः क्षो̱णी शिशु̱ं न मा̱तरा̍ विश्वा̍स्ते̱ स्पृध̍ः श्नथयन्त म̱न्यवे̍ वृ̱त्रं यदि̍न्द्र̱ तूर्व̍सि
287.m: The two worlds followed after your rushing fury, as two mothers follow a child. / All your rivals break before your wrath when you strike down Vṛtra, Indra.

287.s: ya̱jño de̱vānā̱ṃ pratye̍ti su̱mnamādi̍tyāso bhava̍tā mṛḷayanta̍ḥ ā vo̱'rvācī̍ su̱mati̍rvavṛtyāda̱m̐hości̱dyā va̍rivo̱vitta̍rāsa̍t
287.d: य̱ज्ञो दे̱वाना̱ं प्रत्ये̍ति सु̱म्नमादि̍त्यासो भव̍ता मृऌअयन्त̍ः आ वो̱ऽर्वाची̍ सु̱मति̍र्ववृत्याद̱म्̐होश्चि̱द्या व̍रिवो̱वित्त̍रास̍त्
287.m: The sacrifice approaches the favor of the gods; be gracious, Ādityas! / May your goodwill turn toward us, bringing wide space even out of narrowness!

287.s: ada̍bdhebhiḥ savitaḥ pā̱yubhi̱ṣṭvam̐ śi̱vebhi̍ra̱dya pari̍ pāhi no gaya̍m hira̍ṇyajihvaḥ suvi̱tāya̱ navya̍se̱ rakṣā̱ māki̍rno a̱ghaśa̍m̐sa īśata
287.d: अद̍ब्धेभिः सवितः पा̱युभि̱ष्ट्वम्̐ शि̱वेभि̍र̱द्य परि̍ पाहि नो गय̍म् हिर̍ण्यजिह्वः सुवि̱ताय̱ नव्य̍से̱ रक्षा̱ माकि̍र्नो अ̱घश̍म्̐स ईशत
287.m: With unbeguiled, auspicious protections, Savitṛ, guard our household today! / Golden-tongued, protect us for newer well-being; let no slanderer master us!

288.s: (5) pra vī̱rayā̱ śuca̍yo dadrire vāmaddhva̱ryubhi̱rmadhu̍mantaḥ sutāsa̍ḥ vaha̍ vāyo niyuto̍ yāhyacchā̱ pibā̍ sutasyāndha̍so madā̍ya
288.d: (5) प्र वी̱रया̱ शुच̍यो दद्रिरे वामद्ध्व̱र्युभि̱र्मधु̍मन्तः सुतास̍ः वह̍ वायो नियुतो̍ याह्यच्छा̱ पिबा̍ सुतस्यान्ध̍सो मदा̍य
288.m: With heroic force, pure, sweet, pressed by the Adhvaryus, they are offered to you both. / Bring your teams, Vāyu, come hither, drink of the pressed juice for exhilaration!

288.s: gāva̱ upā̍vatāvataṃ ma̱hī ya̱jñasya̍ rapsu̱dā | u̱bhā karṇā̍ hira̱ṇyayā̍
288.d: गाव̱ उपा̍वतावतं म̱ही य̱ज्ञस्य̍ रप्सु̱दा । उ̱भा कर्णा̍ हिर̱ण्यया̍
288.m: The cows approached, protecting the great abundance of the sacrifice, / both golden ears.

288.s: kā̱vyayo̱rājā̍neṣu̱ kratvā̱ dakṣa̍sya duro̱ṇe | ri̱śāda̍sā sa̱dhastha̱ ā
288.d: का̱व्ययो̱राजा̍नेषु̱ क्रत्वा̱ दक्ष̍स्य दुरो̱णे । रि̱शाद̍सा स̱धस्थ̱ आ
288.m: In the lineages of the two Kāvya [sages], through mental power in the home of skill, / the two destroyers of the foe are in the assembly.

288.s: daivyā̍ adhva̱ryū ā ga̍ta̱m̐ rathe̍na̱ sūrya̍tvacā madhvā̍ ya̱jñam̐ sa̍mañjāthe | taṃ pra̱tnathā̱yaṃ ve̱naśco̍dayat
288.d: दैव्या̍ अध्व̱र्यू आ ग̍त̱म्̐ रथे̍न̱ सूर्य̍त्वचा मध्वा̍ य̱ज्ञम्̐ स̍मञ्जाथे । तं प्र̱त्नथा̱यं वे̱नश्चो̍दयत्
288.m: Divine Adhvaryus, come with your chariot skin-clad like Sūrya; / with honey anoint the sacrifice! / As of old, this Vena urged on...

288.s: ti̱ra̱ścīno̱ vita̍to ra̱śmire̍ṣāma̱dhaḥ svi̍dāsī̱3du̱pari̍ svidāsa3t re̱to̱dhā ā̍sanmahi̱māna̍ āsantsva̱dhā a̱vastā̱tpraya̍tiḥ pa̱rastā̍t
288.d: ति̱र̱श्चीनो̱ वित̍तो र̱श्मिरे̍षाम̱धः स्वि̍दासी̱3दु̱परि̍ स्विदास3त् रे̱तो̱धा आ̍सन्महि̱मान̍ आसन्त्स्व̱धा अ̱वस्ता̱त्प्रय̍तिः प̱रस्ता̍त्
288.m:
Across was their cord stretched out: / was it below or was it above?
Seed-placers were there, magnitudes were there; / self-power below, impulse above.

288.s: ā roda̍sī apṛṇādo sva̱rmahañjā̱taṃ yade̍namapa̱so adhā̍rayan so a̍dhva̱rāya̱ pari̍ ṇīyate ka̱viratyo̱ na vāja̍sātaye cano̍hitaḥ
288.d: आ रोद̍सी अपृणादो स्व̱र्महञ्जा̱तं यदे̍नमप̱सो अधा̍रयन् सो अ̍ध्व̱राय̱ परि̍ णीयते क̱विरत्यो̱ न वाज̍सातये चनो̍हितः
288.m:
He filled the two world-halves, he [filled] the great heaven, / when born, whom the active [priests] sustained.
He is led around for the sacrificial rite, the poet, / like a courser for the winning of vital vigor, well-provided.

288.s: u̱kthebhi̍rvṛtra̱hanta̍mā̱ yā ma̍ndā̱nā cidā gi̱rā | āṅgū̱ṣairā̱vivā̍sata:
288.d: उ̱क्थेभि̍र्वृत्र̱हन्त̍मा̱ या म̍न्दा̱ना चिदा गि̱रा । आङ्गू̱षैरा̱विवा̍सत:
288.m: They who, most supreme slayers of Vṛtra, through solemn recitations, / being delighted, even by song / with panegyrics win [the gods].

288.s: upa̍ naḥ sū̱navo̱ gira̍: śṛ̱ṇvantva̱mṛta̍sya̱ ye | su̱mṛ̱ḷī̱kā bha̍vantu naḥ
288.d: उप̍ नः सू̱नवो̱ गिर̍: शृ̱ण्वन्त्व̱मृत̍स्य̱ ये । सु̱मृ̱ऌई̱का भ̍वन्तु नः
288.m:
May the sons of the immortal / hear our songs of praise;
may they be gracious to us.

288.s: brahmā̍ṇi me ma̱taya̱: śam̐ sutāsa̱: śuṣma̍ iyarti̱ prabhṛ̍to me̱ adri̍: ā śāsa̍te̱ prati̍ haryantyu̱kthemā harī̍ vahata̱stā no accha̍
288.d: ब्रह्मा̍णि मे म̱तय̱: शम्̐ सुतास̱: शुष्म̍ इयर्ति̱ प्रभृ̍तो मे̱ अद्रि̍: आ शास̍ते̱ प्रति̍ हर्यन्त्यु̱क्थेमा हरी̍ वहत̱स्ता नो अच्छ̍
288.m:
My sacred formulations, my thoughts [go forth]; pressed out are the [soma-drops] for welfare; / my pressing-stone, advanced, raises its roar.
They long for, they eagerly welcome the recitations; / bring these two bays toward us.

288.s: anu̍ttamā te̍ maghavanna̱kirnu na tvāvā̍m̐2 asti de̱vatā̱ vidā̍naḥ na jāya̍mā̱no naśa̍te̱ na jā̱to yāna̍i kari̱ṣyā kṛ̍ṇu̱hi pra̍vṛddha
288.d: अनु̍त्तमा ते̍ मघवन्न̱किर्नु न त्वावा̍म्̐2 अस्ति दे̱वता̱ विदा̍नः न जाय̍मा̱नो नश̍ते̱ न जा̱तो यान̍इ करि̱ष्या कृ̍णु̱हि प्र̍वृद्ध
288.m:
Unrivalled is your [might], O bounteous one; not one indeed / among the gods is known to be your equal.
Neither one being born nor one born has reached it; / what you will do, do, O grown mighty.

288.s: tadidā̍sa̱ bhuva̍neṣu jye̱ṣṭhaṃ yato̍ ja̱jña u̱grastve̱ṣanṛ̍mṇaḥ sa̱dyo ja̍jñā̱no ni ri̍ṇāti̱ śatrū̱nanu̱ yaṃ viśve̱ mada̍ntyū̱māḥ
288.d: तदिदा̍स̱ भुव̍नेषु ज्ये̱ष्ठं यतो̍ ज̱ज्ञ उ̱ग्रस्त्वे̱षनृ̍म्णः स̱द्यो ज̍ज्ञा̱नो नि रि̍णाति̱ शत्रू̱ननु̱ यं विश्वे̱ मद̍न्त्यू̱माः
288.m:
That indeed was the eldest among the beings, / whence was born the fierce one of burning valor.
As soon as born he crushes his enemies, / he after whom all the supporters exult.

288.s: i̱mā u̍ tvā puruvaso̱ giro̍ vardhantu̱ yā mama̍ pā̱va̱kava̍rṇā̱ḥ śuca̍yo vipa̱ścito̱'bhi stomai̍ranūṣata
288.d: इ̱मा उ̍ त्वा पुरुवसो̱ गिरो̍ वर्धन्तु̱ या मम̍ पा̱व̱कव̍र्णा̱ः शुच̍यो विप̱श्चितो̱ऽभि स्तोमै̍रनूषत
288.m:
May these songs of mine strengthen you, / O lord of manifold wealth;
purifying of hue, bright, the wise poets / have greeted [you] with praise-songs.

288.s: yasyā̱yaṃ viśva̱ āryo̱ dāsa̍ḥ śevadhi̱pā a̱riḥ ti̱raści̍da̱rye ruśa̍me̱ pavī̍ravi̱ tubhyetso a̍jyate ra̱yiḥ
288.d: यस्या̱यं विश्व̱ आर्यो̱ दास̍ः शेवधि̱पा अ̱रिः ति̱रश्चि̍द̱र्ये रुश̍मे̱ पवी̍रवि̱ तुभ्येत्सो अ̍ज्यते र̱यिः
288.m:
To whom belongs every one here, Ārya and Dāsa, / the stranger protecting his treasure;
even across Ruśama, O spear-bearing lord, / to you alone is this wealth driven.

288.s: a̱yam̐ sahasra̱mṛṣi̍bhiḥ saha̍skṛtaḥ samu̱dra i̍va paprathe sa̱tyaḥ so a̍sya mahi̱mā gṛ̍ṇe̱ śavo̍ ya̱jñeṣu̍ vipra̱rājye̍
288.d: अ̱यम्̐ सहस्र̱मृषि̍भिः सह̍स्कृतः समु̱द्र इ̍व पप्रथे स̱त्यः सो अ̍स्य महि̱मा गृ̍णे̱ शवो̍ य̱ज्ञेषु̍ विप्र̱राज्ये̍
288.m:
Made mighty by a thousand ṛṣis, / he has spread out like an ocean.
Real is his greatness; I sing of his might / in sacrifices, in the sovereignty of the sage.
